en.purpose: Provides example workflows for reading, creating, merging, and splitting PDF files.
scenarios: Extract text and metadata from a PDF.
Create a PDF from Markdown, HTML, or drawing commands.
Combine multiple PDFs or split a PDF into individual pages.
Use OCR when a scanned PDF has no extractable text.
en.io: Inputs are PDF, Markdown, or HTML files and optional styling or page-selection parameters. Outputs are extracted text, metadata, newly generated PDFs, merged PDFs, or per-page PDFs.
dependencies: pdftotext from Poppler for text extraction
PyMuPDF (fitz) for reading, merging, and splitting
Pandoc and optionally XeLaTeX for Markdown conversion
wkhtmltopdf or pdfkit for HTML conversion
en.boundary: The evidence provides command and code examples, not an integrated application. Tool availability, encoding, layout fidelity, OCR accuracy, and large-file resource use must be handled by the caller.

zh.purpose: 提供读取、创建、合并和拆分 PDF 文件的示例工作流。
scenarios: 从 PDF 提取文本和元数据。
从 Markdown、HTML 或绘图指令创建 PDF。
合并多个 PDF，或将 PDF 拆分为单页文件。
扫描件无法提取文本时使用 OCR。
zh.io: 输入为 PDF、Markdown 或 HTML 文件，以及可选的样式或页面选择参数；输出为提取的文本、元数据、新建 PDF、合并 PDF 或逐页 PDF。
dependencies: 用于文本提取的 Poppler pdftotext
用于读取、合并和拆分的 PyMuPDF（fitz）
用于 Markdown 转换的 Pandoc，以及可选的 XeLaTeX
用于编程创建 PDF 的 ReportLab
用于 HTML 转换的 wkhtmltopdf 或 pdfkit
可选 OCR 所需的 pytesseract
zh.boundary: 证据仅提供命令和代码示例，并非完整应用。调用方需处理工具可用性、编码、版式保真度、OCR 准确性和大文件资源占用。

grounding.scope: PDF text extraction, creation, merging, splitting, and scanned-document OCR guidance.

en.purpose: Guides creation of basic Model Context Protocol servers that expose callable tools and readable resources to an MCP client.
scenarios: Create a Python MCP server with typed asynchronous tools.
Create a TypeScript server using the MCP SDK and stdio transport.
Wrap an external HTTP API as an MCP tool.
Expose SQLite query results or file-backed resources.
Inspect a server or send a basic JSON-RPC test request.
en.io: Inputs are tool arguments, resource identifiers, JSON-RPC requests, API responses, database rows, or files. Outputs are MCP tool/resource responses, typically text content over stdio.
dependencies: Python mcp package for the Python examples
httpx for the HTTP API example
en.boundary: The evidence is starter guidance rather than a production framework. Authentication, authorization, path confinement, SQL safety, secret handling, schema compatibility, deployment, and robust error handling remain implementation responsibilities.

zh.purpose: 指导创建基础 Model Context Protocol 服务器，向 MCP 客户端暴露可调用工具和可读资源。
scenarios: 创建带类型化异步工具的 Python MCP 服务器。
使用 MCP SDK 和 stdio 传输创建 TypeScript 服务器。
将外部 HTTP API 封装为 MCP 工具。
暴露 SQLite 查询结果或文件型资源。
使用检查器或基础 JSON-RPC 请求测试服务器。
zh.io: 输入包括工具参数、资源标识符、JSON-RPC 请求、API 响应、数据库行或文件；输出为 MCP 工具或资源响应，通常通过 stdio 返回文本内容。
dependencies: Python 示例所需的 mcp 包
Python asyncio 和 stdio 传输
HTTP API 示例所需的 httpx
数据库示例所需的 sqlite3
兼容 MCP 的客户端配置
zh.boundary: 证据属于入门模板，而非生产框架。认证、授权、路径限制、SQL 安全、密钥管理、协议版本兼容、部署和健壮错误处理仍需实现者负责。

grounding.scope: Introductory construction of stdio-based MCP servers in Python or TypeScript, including tools, resources, API access, and testing examples.

en.purpose: Supplies a checklist and report format for identifying defects and improvement opportunities in source code.
scenarios: Review a file or component for logic and error-handling defects.
Look for injection, authorization, credential, or data-exposure problems.
Identify inefficient queries, blocking I/O, leaks, or poor algorithms.
Assess naming, complexity, duplication, dead code, and test coverage.
en.io: Inputs are source code, diffs, repository context, tests, and optional scanner output. Output is a structured review containing a summary, prioritized issues, suggested fixes, positive observations, and a merge-readiness verdict.
dependencies: Optional npm audit, pip-audit, or cargo audit
Optional grep and Git history/diff commands
Optional Radon for Python complexity analysis
en.boundary: The checklist cannot establish correctness or security without adequate context and validation. Automated audit commands are optional external checks, may produce false positives or miss issues, and some example thresholds are heuristics rather than project-specific rules.

zh.purpose: 提供检查清单和报告格式，用于识别源代码缺陷及改进机会。
scenarios: 审查文件或组件中的逻辑与错误处理缺陷。
查找注入、授权、凭据或数据暴露问题。
识别低效查询、阻塞 I/O、资源泄漏或低效算法。
评估命名、复杂度、重复、死代码和测试覆盖。
zh.io: 输入为源代码、差异、仓库上下文、测试和可选扫描器结果；输出为包含摘要、分级问题、修复建议、正面观察和合并就绪结论的结构化审查。
dependencies: 对应语言的源码与测试上下文
可选的 npm audit、pip-audit 或 cargo audit
可选的 grep、Git 历史和差异命令
可选的 Python 复杂度工具 Radon
zh.boundary: 缺少充分上下文和验证时，清单不能证明代码正确或安全。自动审计属于可选外部检查，可能误报或漏报；示例阈值是启发式规则，并非项目专属标准。

grounding.scope: Structured source-code review guidance covering security, correctness, performance, maintainability, and tests.

en.purpose: Frames AI-agent design around a model loop, a small capability set, on-demand knowledge, and controlled conversational context.
scenarios: Define the purpose, domain, capabilities, and knowledge for a new assistant.
Design a minimal agent loop that chooses between tool use and responding.
Add progress tracking when multi-step work loses coherence.
Introduce isolated subagents or on-demand skills when usage demonstrates a need.
en.io: Inputs are a target purpose, operating domain, desired actions, knowledge sources, context constraints, and delegation boundaries. Outputs are an agent architecture or scaffold organized around capabilities, knowledge, context, and optional progressive-complexity mechanisms.
dependencies: A language model capable of choosing actions
A runtime that executes capabilities and feeds results back to the model
Optional referenced Python templates and initialization script, whose contents are not included in this evidence
en.boundary: The evidence presents design philosophy and high-level patterns, not a complete production implementation. It does not specify model-provider integration, persistence, authentication, observability, evaluation, or safeguards for consequential autonomous actions.

zh.purpose: 以模型循环、少量能力、按需知识和受控会话上下文为核心组织 AI 智能体设计。
scenarios: 为新助手定义目标、领域、能力和知识。
设计在调用工具与直接响应之间选择的最小智能体循环。
多步骤工作失去连贯性时加入进度跟踪。
在实际使用表明确有需要时，引入隔离子智能体或按需技能。
zh.io: 输入为目标用途、运行领域、期望动作、知识来源、上下文约束和委派边界；输出为围绕能力、知识、上下文及可选渐进复杂度机制组织的智能体架构或脚手架。
dependencies: 能够选择动作的语言模型
执行能力并将结果反馈给模型的运行时
可选的 Python 模板和初始化脚本；其内容未包含在本证据中
zh.boundary: 证据主要描述设计理念和高层模式，不是完整生产实现；未规定模型供应商集成、持久化、认证、可观测性、评估或高影响自主操作的防护措施。

grounding.scope: Conceptual design guidance for minimal tool-using AI agents and progressive additions such as planning, subagents, and on-demand skills.

en.purpose: Reports aggregate WORK progress and task-level status from task-manager Markdown records.
scenarios: List all WORK items and their completion counts.
Show progress for a specific WORK.
Read completion details for a particular TASK.
Summarize pipeline status using the documented status values.
en.io: Input is an optional WORK or TASK query plus files such as works/WORK-LIST.md, works/WORK-NN/PROGRESS.md, and TASK-NN_result.md. Output is a concise human-readable status summary.
dependencies: A project using the documented works/ directory layout
Per-task result files for detailed completion information
en.boundary: It only interprets status recorded in the expected files. It does not create work, execute tasks, validate completion claims, or define behavior when records are missing, inconsistent, or use another layout.

zh.purpose: 从任务管理器的 Markdown 记录中汇报 WORK 汇总进度和 TASK 级状态。
scenarios: 列出所有 WORK 及其完成数量。
显示指定 WORK 的进度。
读取特定 TASK 的完成详情。
按照文档中的状态值汇总流水线状态。
zh.io: 输入为可选的 WORK 或 TASK 查询，以及 works/WORK-LIST.md、works/WORK-NN/PROGRESS.md、TASK-NN_result.md 等文件；输出为简洁的人类可读状态摘要。
dependencies: 采用规定 works/ 目录布局的项目
用于详细完成信息的 TASK 结果文件
zh.boundary: 仅解释预期文件中记录的状态，不创建工作、不执行任务，也不验证完成声明；对记录缺失、冲突或采用其他布局的情况未作定义。

grounding.scope: Read-only presentation of WORK and TASK progress from a prescribed works-directory document layout.

en.purpose: Routes a square-bracket-tagged request through specifier, planning, scheduling, building, verification, and commit roles according to an execution mode.
scenarios: Start a new-feature or bug-fix workflow from a leading bracketed tag.
Create a requirement package and pause for user approval.
Run a direct, pipeline, or full execution path selected by the specifier.
Skip approval gates when the request explicitly ends with the documented auto marker.
en.io: Input is a user requirement beginning with a square-bracket tag and an optional auto suffix. Outputs are pipeline artifacts under works/ and summaries or approval prompts produced by the participating roles.
dependencies: Specifier, planner, scheduler, builder, verifier, and committer agent roles
An orchestration runtime capable of invoking the roles and pausing for approval
en.boundary: The evidence defines routing and gates but not the referenced role prompts or artifact schemas. It depends on side effects by multiple agents; automatic mode intentionally removes approval pauses but does not itself define additional safety controls.

zh.purpose: 依据执行模式，将以方括号标签开头的请求交由规格、规划、调度、构建、验证和提交角色处理。
scenarios: 通过开头的功能或缺陷标签启动工作流。
创建需求材料后暂停并请求用户批准。
执行规格角色选定的 direct、pipeline 或 full 路径。
请求以规定的 auto 标记结尾时跳过审批停顿。
zh.io: 输入为以方括号标签开头的用户需求及可选 auto 后缀；输出为 works/ 下的流水线产物，以及各角色产生的摘要或审批提示。
dependencies: 同级 sdd-pipeline 参考资料，尤其是 references/agent-flow.md
能够调用角色并在审批处暂停的编排运行时
zh.boundary: 证据规定了路由和审批门，但未包含被引用的角色提示词或产物模式。该流程依赖多个智能体产生副作用；自动模式会明确取消审批停顿，但未额外定义安全控制。

grounding.scope: Orchestration trigger for tagged requests in a specification-driven WORK pipeline with approval gates and execution modes.

en.purpose: Prepares a project for the uc-taskmanager workflow by ensuring a works/ directory exists and optionally merging a predefined permission allowlist into local settings.
scenarios: Initialize uc-taskmanager in a project that lacks works/.
Preserve an existing works/ directory.
Ask before configuring local Bash, read, edit, and write permissions.
Merge missing permissions without duplicating or deleting existing allow or deny entries.
en.io: Inputs are the current project, the user's permission-setup decision, and an optional existing .claude/settings.local.json. Outputs are a works/ directory, an updated settings file when approved, and an initialization summary.
dependencies: Filesystem write access in the project
Claude settings format with permissions.allow and permissions.deny arrays
en.boundary: The procedure changes project files and proposes a very broad allowlist, including unrestricted-looking file permissions plus Git, curl, and language tool commands. It does not validate whether each permission is necessary for a specific project or describe rollback beyond preserving existing entries.

zh.purpose: 通过确保 works/ 目录存在，并可选地将预设权限白名单合并到本地设置，为 uc-taskmanager 工作流准备项目。
scenarios: 在缺少 works/ 的项目中初始化 uc-taskmanager。
保留已有 works/ 目录。
配置本地 Bash、读取、编辑和写入权限前先征得用户同意。
合并缺失权限，不重复也不删除已有 allow 或 deny 项。
zh.io: 输入为当前项目、用户对权限设置的决定，以及可选的 .claude/settings.local.json；输出为 works/ 目录、经批准后更新的设置文件和初始化摘要。
dependencies: 项目内的文件系统写权限
修改权限前的用户批准
包含 permissions.allow 和 permissions.deny 数组的 Claude 设置格式
zh.boundary: 该流程会修改项目文件，并提出范围很宽的允许列表，包括近似不受限的文件权限以及 Git、curl 和语言工具命令。它不会验证每项权限对具体项目是否必要，也未提供除保留原条目外的回滚方案。

grounding.scope: Initialization procedure for a uc-taskmanager project directory and Claude-local permission configuration.

en.purpose: Directs a QA role to inspect a codebase or selected paths and produce a dated security-audit report without applying fixes.
scenarios: Perform a pre-release security review.
Audit authentication, authorization, or data-handling changes.
Scan for exposed secrets and dependency vulnerabilities.
Check Solidity code for reentrancy, overflow, and access-control issues when present.
en.io: Input is an optional source-path scope; otherwise the documented default is src/. Output is docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md containing severity-organized findings, scan results, a verdict, and recommended fix order.
dependencies: A Centinela QA agent or equivalent reviewer
SIGN IN, Security Verification, Quality Verification, TIME OUT, and Non-Normal checklists referenced but not included in the evidence
Access to the scoped code and dependency manifests
en.boundary: The workflow is assessment-only and explicitly does not fix vulnerabilities. The evidence does not specify scanner implementations, severity criteria, checklist contents, or proof that an OWASP category has been exhaustively tested.

zh.purpose: 指导 QA 角色检查代码库或指定路径，并生成带日期的安全审计报告，不直接修复问题。
scenarios: 发布前执行安全审查。
审计认证、授权或数据处理相关变更。
扫描泄露密钥和依赖漏洞。
存在 Solidity 时检查重入、溢出和访问控制问题。
zh.io: 输入为可选源码路径范围；未指定时文档默认使用 src/。输出为 docs/reviews/security-audit-{date}.md，包含按严重性组织的问题、扫描结果、结论和建议修复顺序。
dependencies: Centinela QA 智能体或等效审查者
证据未包含的 SIGN IN、Security Verification、Quality Verification、TIME OUT 和 Non-Normal 清单
对目标代码和依赖清单的访问
zh.boundary: 该工作流只评估，明确不修复漏洞。证据未规定扫描器实现、严重性判定标准、清单内容，也不能证明对 OWASP 类别进行了穷尽验证。

grounding.scope: Documented codebase security-audit workflow covering OWASP categories, secrets, dependencies, authentication, authorization, data handling, and optional Solidity checks.

en.purpose: Identifies the rule and schema documents consumed by pipeline agents rather than exposing a direct end-user workflow.
scenarios: Locate the pipeline flow definition.
Locate schemas for generated files and XML communication.
Locate shared TASK, PLAN, WORK-LIST, context-window, and activity-log rules.
en.io: Input is an internal agent's need for a pipeline rule or schema. Output is a reference-document location selected from the listed files.
en.boundary: Only an index and brief document descriptions are present. The referenced contents are not included in the supplied evidence, so the actual orchestration rules, schemas, and validation behavior cannot be assessed here.

zh.purpose: 标识流水线智能体使用的规则与模式文档，本身不是面向终端用户的直接工作流。
scenarios: 定位流水线流程定义。
定位生成文件和 XML 通信模式。
定位 TASK、PLAN、WORK-LIST、上下文窗口和活动日志的共享规则。
zh.io: 输入为内部智能体对某项流水线规则或模式的需求；输出为从列出的文件中选定的参考文档位置。
zh.boundary: 所附证据只有索引和简短文档说明，未包含引用文件正文，因此无法据此评估实际编排规则、模式和验证行为。

grounding.scope: Index of internal reference documents used by a specification-driven development pipeline.

en.purpose: Guides a development role through understanding, prioritizing, fixing, testing, and reporting on code-review findings.
scenarios: Fix critical findings before lower-priority warnings.
Update tests alongside each review-driven correction.
Document justified deferrals for warnings.
Prepare a fix report for QA re-verification.
en.io: Input is a specified review-report path or, by convention, the most recent report in docs/reviews/. Outputs are code and test changes plus a fix report describing resolutions and deferrals.
dependencies: A Forja development agent or equivalent implementer
SIGN IN, Implementation Complete, Pre-Delivery, and TIME OUT checklists referenced but not included
en.boundary: The workflow performs repository modifications and relies on an external review report's correctness. The evidence does not define how the latest report is selected, how conflicting findings are resolved, or what constitutes adequate re-verification.

zh.purpose: 指导开发角色理解、排序、修复、测试并汇报代码审查问题。
scenarios: 先修复严重问题，再处理警告。
为每项审查驱动的修复同步更新测试。
记录有理由延期处理的警告。
准备供 QA 重新验证的修复报告。
zh.io: 输入为指定审查报告路径，或按约定选取 docs/reviews/ 中最新报告；输出为代码和测试变更，以及说明已解决项和延期项的修复报告。
dependencies: Forja 开发智能体或等效实现者
已有 QA 审查报告
证据未包含的 SIGN IN、Implementation Complete、Pre-Delivery 和 TIME OUT 清单
zh.boundary: 该流程会修改仓库，并依赖外部审查报告的准确性。证据未定义如何选取“最新”报告、如何解决冲突问题或何种结果算充分重新验证。

grounding.scope: Development workflow for addressing critical and warning findings recorded in a QA review report.

en.purpose: Coordinates a final QA assessment and records whether a named version is ready for release or blocked.
scenarios: Verify a release candidate before production deployment.
Check CHANGELOG, technical-debt records, specifications, and documentation.
Run tests and code-health checks.
Perform the final security and release-readiness gate.
en.io: Input is a version identifier and the repository's release artifacts. Output is docs/reviews/release-check-{version}.md with documentation, testing, quality, and security results plus a READY FOR RELEASE or BLOCKED verdict.
dependencies: A Centinela QA agent or equivalent reviewer
CHANGELOG, TECH_DEBT, specifications, and other release documentation
SIGN IN, TIME OUT, quality, security, and release-readiness checklists referenced but not included
en.boundary: This is an assessment and report workflow; it does not deploy or tag a release. The evidence does not define quantitative passing thresholds or guarantee that all project-specific release requirements are covered.

zh.purpose: 协调最终 QA 评估，并记录指定版本可以发布还是被阻止。
scenarios: 生产部署前验证候选版本。
检查 CHANGELOG、技术债记录、规格和文档。
运行测试和代码健康检查。
执行最终安全与发布就绪门禁。
zh.io: 输入为版本标识和仓库发布产物；输出为 docs/reviews/release-check-{version}.md，包含文档、测试、质量、安全结果，以及 READY FOR RELEASE 或 BLOCKED 结论。
dependencies: Centinela QA 智能体或等效审查者
项目测试和代码健康工具
证据未包含的 SIGN IN、TIME OUT、质量、安全和发布就绪清单
zh.boundary: 这是评估和报告工作流，不部署也不创建版本标签。证据未定义量化通过阈值，也不能保证覆盖项目特有的全部发布要求。

grounding.scope: Pre-release assessment workflow for documentation, tests, code quality, security, and release readiness.

en.purpose: Loads selected durable context at session start and surfaces only decisions, drift, blockers, dropped work, and open threads needing attention.
scenarios: Validate that AIGENT_ROOT or AIGENT_VAULT resolves to a configured vault.
Route an unready installation to first-run setup.
Recover a newer unbanked session capture into the session log.
Read prioritized memory, daily notes, delegation state, decisions, and runtime state.
Trigger periodic skill-gap or weekly reconciliation checks when due.
en.io: Inputs are environment-resolved vault paths, .aigent state markers, and Markdown or JSON memory records. Outputs are a brief session orientation, refreshed runtime state, and in limited recovery cases an updated session log.
en.boundary: The protocol applies only to a preconfigured aigent-OS vault and must stop if validation fails. Most operations are reads, but recovery and runtime refresh can write or execute a daemon; the contents and behavior of referenced scripts and auxiliary skills are not included in the evidence.

zh.purpose: 在会话开始时加载精选持久上下文，仅提示需要关注的决策、注意力偏移、阻塞、遗落工作和开放事项。
scenarios: 验证 AIGENT_ROOT 或 AIGENT_VAULT 是否指向已配置 vault。
将未就绪安装引导至首次运行设置。
将更新的未归档会话捕获恢复到会话日志。
读取高优先级记忆、每日记录、委派状态、决策和运行时状态。
到期时触发技能缺口或每周对账检查。
zh.io: 输入为通过环境变量解析的 vault 路径、.aigent 状态标记以及 Markdown 或 JSON 记忆记录；输出为简短会话导向、刷新的运行时状态，并在有限恢复场景中更新会话日志。
dependencies: 已有 vault/memory 与 vault/daily 目录
被引用的 /start、/skill-hunt 和 /reconcile 能力
文档规定的 vault 记忆文件
zh.boundary: 该协议仅适用于已配置的 aigent-OS vault，验证失败必须停止。多数操作为读取，但恢复和运行时刷新可能写入或执行守护脚本；所引用脚本及辅助技能的实际内容未包含在证据中。

grounding.scope: Session-start protocol for a configured aigent-OS vault, including contextual recall, recovery checks, priority reconciliation, and runtime-state refresh.

en.purpose: Guides a development role from an approved feature specification to implementation, tests, and a structured QA handoff.
scenarios: Implement a named feature whose specification has been approved.
Create an ADR for a significant architectural decision.
Define interfaces before writing implementation code.
Add unit and integration tests and prepare QA instructions.
en.io: Input is a feature name or path to an approved specification. Outputs are implementation files under src/, tests under tests/, optional ADRs, and handoff notes describing changes, testing, and known limitations.
dependencies: A Forja development agent or equivalent implementer
SIGN IN, Implementation Complete, Pre-Delivery, TIME OUT, and SIGN OUT checklists referenced but not included
Build and test tooling appropriate to the project
en.boundary: The evidence defines a generic workflow, not language- or framework-specific implementation rules. It assumes an adequate approved specification and does not itself perform independent QA, deployment, or release approval.

zh.purpose: 指导开发角色从已批准功能规格推进到实现、测试和结构化 QA 交接。
scenarios: 实现已有批准规格的命名功能。
为重大架构决策创建 ADR。
先定义接口，再编写实现代码。
增加单元和集成测试，并准备 QA 测试说明。
zh.io: 输入为功能名称或已批准规格的路径；输出为 src/ 下的实现、tests/ 下的测试、可选 ADR，以及说明变更、测试方法和已知限制的交接记录。
dependencies: Forja 开发智能体或等效实现者
项目源码与测试目录结构
证据未包含的 SIGN IN、Implementation Complete、Pre-Delivery、TIME OUT 和 SIGN OUT 清单
适合项目的构建与测试工具
zh.boundary: 证据规定的是通用流程，不包含语言或框架专属实现规则。它假设规格充分且已批准，本身不执行独立 QA、部署或发布批准。

grounding.scope: Specification-driven implementation workflow covering architecture, contracts, source code, tests, validation checkpoints, and QA handoff.

en.purpose: Guides a product-management role in converting a feature request into a reviewable specification.
scenarios: Define a new feature or business requirement.
Write user stories with GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria.
Separate in-scope and out-of-scope work.
Record dependencies, risks, success measures, open questions, and developer handoff notes.
en.io: Input is a feature description. Output is docs/specs/{feature-name}.md containing the problem, metrics, stories, acceptance criteria, scope, dependencies, risks, questions, and handoff information.
dependencies: A Prometeo product-management agent or equivalent spec author
Access to existing specifications for conflict research
SIGN IN, Spec Completion, TIME OUT, and SIGN OUT checklists referenced but not included
en.boundary: The workflow writes a specification but does not implement or verify the feature. It expects clarification rather than guessing, while the evidence does not define the exact specification template, naming normalization, or approval mechanism.

zh.purpose: 指导产品管理角色将功能请求转换为可评审规格。
scenarios: 定义新功能或业务需求。
编写带 GIVEN/WHEN/THEN 验收标准的用户故事。
区分范围内和范围外工作。
记录依赖、风险、成功指标、开放问题和开发交接说明。
zh.io: 输入为功能描述；输出为 docs/specs/{feature-name}.md，包含问题、指标、故事、验收标准、范围、依赖、风险、问题和交接信息。
dependencies: Prometeo 产品管理智能体或等效规格作者
用于冲突研究的现有规格访问权限
证据未包含的 SIGN IN、Spec Completion、TIME OUT 和 SIGN OUT 清单
zh.boundary: 该工作流只编写规格，不实现也不验证功能。它要求遇到不明确内容时询问，而非猜测；但证据未定义确切规格模板、名称规范化或审批机制。

grounding.scope: Product-feature specification workflow producing structured scope, stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and developer handoff.

en.purpose: Directs a QA role to scan source, tests, and configuration files and produce a prioritized code-health report.
scenarios: Run a periodic codebase hygiene review.
Assess cleanliness after a large refactor.
Check dead code and unresolved debt before a release.
Inventory outdated or vulnerable dependencies, complexity, nesting, and duplication.
en.io: Input is the repository's source, test, configuration, dependency, and prior-review material. Output is docs/reviews/code-health-{date}.md with verified findings prioritized as Critical, Warning, or Suggestion.
dependencies: A Centinela QA agent or equivalent reviewer
Language-specific dead-code and dependency inspection tools
Access to source, tests, config, and previous scan reports
SIGN IN and Scan Complete/TIME OUT checklists referenced but not included
en.boundary: The workflow reports findings and hands them to development; it does not apply fixes. Claims of avoiding false positives depend on reviewer validation, and the evidence does not define concrete analyzers or universal thresholds for code smells.

zh.purpose: 指导 QA 角色扫描源码、测试和配置文件，并生成按优先级组织的代码健康报告。
scenarios: 执行周期性代码库卫生检查。
大型重构后评估代码整洁度。
发布前检查死代码和未解决技术债。
盘点过期或有漏洞的依赖、复杂度、深层嵌套和重复。
zh.io: 输入为仓库源码、测试、配置、依赖信息和历史审查材料；输出为 docs/reviews/code-health-{date}.md，其中已验证问题按 Critical、Warning、Suggestion 排序。
dependencies: Centinela QA 智能体或等效审查者
对应语言的死代码与依赖检查工具
对源码、测试、配置及历史扫描报告的访问
证据未包含的 SIGN IN 和 Scan Complete/TIME OUT 清单
zh.boundary: 该流程只报告问题并交接给开发，不应用修复。避免误报的说法依赖审查者验证；证据未定义具体分析器或通用代码异味阈值。

grounding.scope: Codebase hygiene assessment for dead code, technical debt, dependency state, code smells, and TODO/FIXME records.

en.purpose: Commits material session outcomes to durable vault memory and establishes a clean, recoverable next-session pickup point.
scenarios: Validate the configured vault before any mutation.
Record consequential work, trust claims, failures, decision outcomes, and staged memories.
Update affected project, person, concept, priority, delegation, and session records.
Create a context capsule when workload or context conditions require it.
Rebuild memory heat, run system checks, refresh runtime state, and stamp a successful close.
en.io: Inputs are session outcomes, a validated vault, existing memory records, state markers, and daemon results. Outputs include updated Markdown and JSON/JSONL memory artifacts, optional capsules, refreshed indexes/runtime state, a concise commit summary, and .aigent/last-close after required writes succeed.
dependencies: Memory-heat, usage-sync, system-check, and runtime-state daemons
Node.js, Python, and shell where the documented daemons require them
Stable session and record identifiers for idempotency
en.boundary: This is a broad mutation protocol restricted to a verified vault. It must not advance the close marker after required-write failures. The evidence does not include the invoked daemon or auxiliary-skill implementations, and several conditional ledger or capsule decisions require judgment from session context.

zh.purpose: 将重要会话结果提交到持久 vault 记忆，并建立清晰、可恢复的下次会话接续点。
scenarios: 任何修改前验证已配置 vault。
记录重要工作、信任声明、失败、决策结果和暂存记忆。
更新受影响的项目、人员、概念、优先级、委派和会话记录。
在工作量或上下文条件满足时创建上下文胶囊。
重建记忆热度、运行系统检查、刷新运行时状态，并在成功后写入关闭时间。
zh.io: 输入为会话结果、已验证 vault、现有记忆记录、状态标记和守护脚本结果；输出包括更新的 Markdown、JSON/JSONL 记忆产物、可选胶囊、刷新后的索引与运行时状态、简短提交摘要，以及必需写入成功后的 .aigent/last-close。
dependencies: 已有 vault/memory 与 vault/daily 结构
被引用的 /honesty-check 和 /digest 能力
记忆热度、用量同步、系统检查和运行时状态守护脚本
相关守护脚本所需的 Node.js、Python 和 shell
用于幂等性的稳定会话与记录标识
zh.boundary: 这是一个仅限已验证 vault 的广泛写入协议。必要写入失败后不得推进关闭标记。证据未包含所调用守护脚本或辅助技能的实现，多个账本或胶囊条件也需要依据会话上下文作判断。

grounding.scope: Idempotent end-of-session persistence protocol for a validated aigent-OS vault, including ledgers, daily notes, capsules, indexes, checks, runtime state, and close stamping.

en.purpose: Documents workflows for discovering Airtable schemas, creating and mutating records, filtering records with formulas, modifying selected schema metadata, and listing record comments.
scenarios: List bases and inspect table and field schemas.
Create, retrieve, update, or delete single or batched records.
Filter and sort records using Airtable formulas.
Create fields or update field and table metadata.
List comments attached to a record.
en.io: Inputs include Airtable base, table, record, and field IDs; exact field names and values; formula filters; sorts; pagination offsets; typecast flags; schema definitions; and record batches. Outputs are schema, record, and comment records or remote mutation results.
dependencies: Rube MCP with runtime schema lookup
en.boundary: Batch record mutations are documented with a maximum of 10 records, and list pages with at most 100 records. Field names are case-sensitive. Field updates do not change field type or options, and computed fields are described as unavailable for creation. Delete operations modify remote records.

zh.purpose: 描述发现 Airtable 模式、创建和修改记录、使用公式筛选记录、修改部分模式元数据以及列出记录评论的流程。
scenarios: 列出 base 并检查表和字段模式。
创建、获取、更新或删除单条及批量记录。
使用 Airtable 公式筛选和排序记录。
创建字段或更新字段与表的元数据。
列出记录上的评论。
zh.io: 输入包括 Airtable base、表、记录和字段 ID，精确字段名及值、公式筛选器、排序、分页偏移量、typecast 标志、模式定义和记录批次。输出为模式、记录和评论数据或远程变更结果。
dependencies: 支持运行时模式查询的 Rube MCP
通过 Composio 建立的有效 Airtable 认证
相应 Airtable base 权限
zh.boundary: 证据所述批量记录变更上限为每次 10 条，列表每页最多 100 条。字段名区分大小写。字段更新不能改变字段类型或选项，且不能通过所述 API 创建计算字段。删除操作会修改远程记录。

grounding.scope: Airtable base, table, record, field, and comment automation through Rube MCP.

en.purpose: Guides an agent in adding lightweight product analytics, querying project performance, and running conversion experiments using Agent Analytics.
scenarios: Create an analytics project and add automatic page-view tracking.
Instrument a small set of high-value custom events.
Inspect traffic, pages, sessions, funnels, retention, and activity times.
Create, read, and complete an A/B experiment.
Verify recently emitted events.
en.io: Inputs include an Agent Analytics API key, project name and domain, browser events and properties, query periods, funnel steps, or experiment definitions. Outputs include a project write token and tracking snippet, recorded events, analytical summaries, and experiment probabilities, lift, or recommendations.
dependencies: AGENT_ANALYTICS_API_KEY or a token supplied during login
Agent Analytics hosted service or a self-hosted deployment
A web application capable of loading the tracker and calling window.aa
en.boundary: The evidence describes one analytics platform and its claimed behavior. It does not independently establish privacy properties, statistical validity, availability, or schema stability; experiments need sufficient exposure, and instrumentation changes still require application access and deployment.

zh.purpose: 指导智能体使用 Agent Analytics 添加轻量产品分析、查询项目表现并运行转化实验。
scenarios: 创建分析项目并添加自动页面浏览追踪。
埋点少量高价值自定义事件。
查看流量、页面、会话、漏斗、留存和活跃时段。
创建、读取和结束 A/B 实验。
验证新近发送的事件。
zh.io: 输入包括 Agent Analytics API 密钥、项目名称与域名、浏览器事件与属性、查询周期、漏斗步骤或实验定义；输出包括项目写入令牌和追踪片段、已记录事件、分析摘要，以及实验概率、提升或建议。
dependencies: AGENT_ANALYTICS_API_KEY 或登录时提供的令牌
Agent Analytics 托管服务或自托管部署
能够加载追踪器并调用 window.aa 的 Web 应用
zh.boundary: 证据描述的是特定分析平台及其自述行为，并未独立证明隐私属性、统计有效性、可用性或模式稳定性。实验需要足够曝光量，埋点变更仍需应用访问和部署。

grounding.scope: Agent Analytics setup, event instrumentation, querying, funnel and retention analysis, and A/B experiment management through its CLI and browser tracker.

en.purpose: Documents tool sequences and parameter conventions for automating common ActiveCampaign CRM and marketing operations through Rube MCP.
scenarios: Find or create a contact.
Add or remove contact tags.
Subscribe or unsubscribe a contact from a list.
Enroll an existing contact in an automation.
Create a dated follow-up task associated with a contact.
en.io: Inputs include contact emails or IDs, names, phone numbers, tags, list and automation IDs, task types, due dates, and actions. Outputs are contact records or mutation results returned by the current ActiveCampaign tools exposed through Rube MCP.
dependencies: Rube MCP with RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS and RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS
An active Composio connection for the active_campaign toolkit
An ActiveCampaign account and configured lists, automations, users, and task types
Current tool schemas discovered before use
en.boundary: The workflow depends on live third-party schemas and authentication. It cannot create ActiveCampaign automations and may require IDs from the ActiveCampaign UI. Mutations can affect customer records and subscriptions; callers must handle authorization, identity matching, rate limits, response nesting, date validity, and duplicate-contact behavior.

zh.purpose: 记录通过 Rube MCP 自动执行常见 ActiveCampaign CRM 与营销操作的工具顺序和参数约定。
scenarios: 查找或创建联系人。
添加或移除联系人标签。
将联系人订阅到列表或取消订阅。
把已有联系人加入自动化流程。
创建关联联系人的定时跟进任务。
zh.io: 输入包括联系人邮箱或 ID、姓名、电话、标签、列表与自动化 ID、任务类型、截止时间和动作；输出为 Rube MCP 当前暴露的 ActiveCampaign 工具返回的联系人记录或变更结果。
dependencies: 带 RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS 和 RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS 的 Rube MCP
Composio 中 active_campaign 工具包的有效连接
ActiveCampaign 账户及已配置的列表、自动化、用户和任务类型
操作前发现的最新工具模式
zh.boundary: 该工作流依赖实时第三方模式和认证，不能创建 ActiveCampaign 自动化，部分 ID 需从 ActiveCampaign 界面获取。变更会影响客户记录和订阅；调用方需处理授权、身份匹配、速率限制、响应嵌套、日期有效性和重复联系人行为。

grounding.scope: ActiveCampaign contact, tag, list-subscription, automation-enrollment, and contact-task operations through Composio's Rube MCP toolkit.

en.purpose: Combines deterministic correction rules with a full-context native AI pass to correct plausible ASR errors while preserving speech, speaker labels, unresolved text, and correction provenance.
scenarios: Clean meeting or interview transcripts.
Correct mixed Chinese-English technical terms and homophones.
Review uncertain names, entities, or decision-bearing numbers with a queue and optional audio evidence.
en.io: Input: transcript file, optional project domains and context, global and project identity rosters, dictionaries, and optional source audio. Output: corrected transcript, Stage 1 JSON telemetry, change and review sidecars, persistent review items, numeric or trap scans, and reusable confirmed corrections.
dependencies: Claude Code or Codex for the default native pass
uv and bundled Python entry points
Configured correction database, domain contexts, and people rosters when applicable
Review dashboard and human decisions for unresolved items
Optional permitted second recognizer and source audio
GLM API key only for the separate agent-less API route
en.boundary: Stage 1 alone is explicitly incomplete. It forbids fluency rewriting and identity inference; uncertain text stays unchanged and blocks a final-quality claim until resolved. Person-name changes require both global and project identity sources. API degradation, missing audio, or pending review items must remain visible.

zh.purpose: 把确定性规则与通读全文的原生 AI 校正结合起来，在保留原话、说话人标签、未解决文本和校正来源的前提下修复合理的 ASR 错误。
scenarios: 清理会议或访谈转写。
修正中英混合技术词和同音误识别。
通过复核队列和可选音频证据处理不确定姓名、实体或关键数字。
zh.io: 输入：转写文件、可选项目领域与上下文、全局及项目身份名册、词典和可选原始音频。输出：校正后转写、Stage 1 JSON 遥测、变更/待复核侧文件、持久复核项、数字或陷阱扫描及确认后的复用规则。
dependencies: 默认原生校正所需的 Claude Code 或 Codex
uv 和随附 Python 入口
适用时配置的校正数据库、领域上下文和人员名册
解决不确定项所需的复核面板和人工决定
可选且获准的第二识别器及原始音频
仅用于无代理 API 路线的 GLM API 密钥
zh.boundary: Stage 1 明确不代表完成。禁止为流畅而改写，也禁止推断身份；不确定文本保持原样，未解决前不能声称最终质量。人名修改必须同时查全局和项目身份来源；API 降级、缺失音频和待复核项必须显式保留。

en.purpose: Generates Chinese or Japanese speech with StepFun stepaudio-2.5-tts using natural-language global instructions and inline parenthetical prosody directions.
scenarios: Synthesize emotional or whispered speech with sentence-level prosody changes.
Batch-generate game or application voice lines.
Migrate integrations from step-tts-2 voice_label parameters to stepaudio-2.5-tts instructions.
en.io: Inputs are text up to the documented model limit, optional instruction text, batch JSONL, voice/model settings, and an output path. Outputs are synthesized audio files plus batch logs or skipped-line records.
dependencies: STEPFUN_API_KEY or plugin config containing a Normal API key
Optional shell comparison tooling for A/B evaluation
en.boundary: Targets TTS, not transcription. The model rejects legacy voice_label, limits instruction and input length, and may block sensitive content. Pricing and service behavior are volatile and require external re-verification.

zh.purpose: 使用 StepFun 的 stepaudio-2.5-tts，通过自然语言全局指令和文本内括号韵律指令生成中文或日文语音。
scenarios: 合成带情绪、耳语或句内语气变化的语音。
批量生成游戏或应用配音台词。
将 step-tts-2 的 voice_label 集成迁移到 stepaudio-2.5-tts 的 instruction 方式。
zh.io: 输入为受模型长度限制的文本、可选 instruction、批量 JSONL、音色/模型设置和输出路径；输出为合成音频，以及批处理日志或跳过记录。
dependencies: STEPFUN_API_KEY 或插件配置中的 Normal API Key
内置 Python 生成脚本
A/B 对比可选的 Shell 工具
zh.boundary: 仅用于语音合成，不用于转写。模型不接受旧版 voice_label，并限制 instruction 和输入长度，也可能拦截敏感内容。价格和服务行为具有时效性，引用前需重新核实。

en.purpose: Transcribes Chinese or English audio through StepFun stepaudio-2.5-asr using its JSON/base64 SSE endpoint and extracts authoritative final text and usage data.
scenarios: Transcribe short or long recordings in one request when within service limits.
Migrate from older StepFun ASR models.
Diagnose wrong-endpoint, key-type, censorship-event, or repetitive-output failures.
en.io: Inputs are supported audio files, language/format options, and an API key. Outputs are plain transcript text or JSON containing text, usage, and timing information.
dependencies: STEPFUN_API_KEY or plugin config with a Normal API key
ffmpeg for unsupported containers or files exceeding the single-call duration limit
en.boundary: Uses a StepFun-hosted service and does not provide speaker diarization or transcript cleanup. It must parse SSE error events and take final text from the done event. Audio beyond the stated ceiling must be split externally, and pricing/performance claims may change.

zh.purpose: 通过 StepFun stepaudio-2.5-asr 的 JSON/base64 SSE 接口转写中英文音频，并提取权威最终文本和用量数据。
scenarios: 在服务限制内单次转写短音频或较长录音。
从旧版 StepFun ASR 模型迁移。
诊断错误端点、密钥类型、内容拦截事件或重复幻觉问题。
zh.io: 输入为受支持的音频文件、语言/格式选项和 API Key；输出为纯文本转写或包含文本、用量与耗时信息的 JSON。
dependencies: STEPFUN_API_KEY 或插件配置中的 Normal API Key
处理不支持容器或超时长文件时所需的 ffmpeg
zh.boundary: 依赖 StepFun 托管服务，不提供说话人分离或转写清理。必须处理 SSE error 事件，并以 done 事件的最终文本为准。超过单次时长限制的音频需外部分割，价格和性能数据可能变化。

en.purpose: Transforms meeting transcripts into structured, evidence-backed minutes through redundant complete passes, union merging, completeness review, and human validation.
scenarios: Create minutes with decisions, action items, discussion, open questions, and supporting quotes.
Merge several minutes drafts without losing unique content.
Audit existing notes against a transcript or identify anonymous speakers with user-confirmed mappings.
en.io: Inputs are transcripts, optional project/team context, reference artifacts, and external draft minutes. Outputs are Markdown minutes, intermediate complete-pass drafts, diagrams, retrieval-test claims, and review statistics.
dependencies: Readable transcript and optional context files
Multiple isolated agent passes for the specified full workflow
Optional transcript-fixer and document conversion tools
en.boundary: Structures transcript evidence rather than correcting ASR. Speaker identity must not be silently inferred; source-side labeling or user confirmation is preferred. Drafts require human review, and claims from external drafts must be verified against the transcript.

zh.purpose: 通过多次独立完整生成、并集合并、完整性审查和人工确认，将会议转写整理为有证据支撑的结构化纪要。
scenarios: 生成包含决策、行动项、讨论、开放问题和原文引述的会议纪要。
合并多份纪要版本并保留各版本独有内容。
对照原始转写审查现有纪要，或在用户确认下识别匿名说话人。
zh.io: 输入为会议转写、可选项目/团队上下文、参考材料和外部纪要草稿；输出为 Markdown 纪要、多轮中间稿、图表、检索自测声明及审查统计。
dependencies: 可读取的转写和可选上下文文件
完整流程要求的多次隔离代理生成
Markdown 与 Mermaid 渲染能力
可选的 transcript-fixer 和文档转换工具
zh.boundary: 用于组织转写证据，不负责纠正 ASR。不得静默猜测说话人身份，应优先使用源平台标注或用户确认。产物是需人工审阅的草稿，外部版本中的内容必须回到原转写核验。

en.purpose: Builds auditable competitor profiles and landscapes from locally inspected repository evidence, supplemented by sourced market facts and explicitly separated judgments.
scenarios: Discover and shortlist relevant open-source competitors.
Profile a competitor's implementation, dependencies, capabilities, and direction.
Compare competitors and derive evidence-linked gaps or opportunities.
en.io: Inputs are a product scope, target segment, competitor repository URLs or search terms, local clones, and public market sources. Outputs are source registers, cited technical profiles, comparison tables, and qualified opportunity/risk analyses.
dependencies: GitHub CLI for discovery and repository metadata
Web access for official market, pricing, or activity sources
Bundled update script and report templates
en.boundary: Technical conclusions require local code and file:line evidence; UI appearance alone is insufficient. Market facts need sources and retrieval dates. Missing evidence is marked for verification rather than guessed, and opportunity statements remain judgments rather than code facts.

zh.purpose: 基于本地检查的代码仓库证据构建可审计的竞品档案和竞争格局，并补充有来源的市场事实，同时明确区分事实与判断。
scenarios: 发现并筛选相关开源竞品。
分析竞品的实现、依赖、能力和近期方向。
比较多个竞品并提炼有证据关联的差距与机会。
zh.io: 输入为产品范围、目标客群、竞品仓库 URL 或搜索词、本地克隆和公开市场信源；输出为来源登记、带引用的技术档案、对比表及附条件的机会/风险分析。
dependencies: 用于发现与元数据查询的 GitHub CLI
查询官方市场、价格或活跃度信息所需的网络访问
内置更新脚本和报告模板
zh.boundary: 技术结论必须来自本地代码和 file:line 证据，不能仅凭界面推断。市场事实须附来源和获取日期。证据不足时应标为待验证，不得猜测；机会属于分析判断而非代码事实。

en.purpose: Investigates Cloudflare delivery problems by querying actual zone configuration, checking related layers, applying narrowly scoped fixes, and verifying results.
scenarios: Diagnose redirect loops and SSL/TLS mode conflicts.
Investigate DNS, DNSSEC, certificate, firewall, load-balancer, or origin errors.
Inspect Cloudflare settings before changing configuration.
en.io: Inputs are a domain, Cloudflare zone/account access, observed symptoms, and origin details. Outputs are configuration evidence, a root-cause assessment, optional API mutations, and post-change verification results.
dependencies: Scoped API token or Global API key plus account email
curl and JSON parsing such as jq
dig and openssl for external DNS/TLS checks
en.boundary: Requires authorized access to the affected Cloudflare account. Investigation should begin read-only; changes and cache purges modify live delivery state. Credentials must not be logged, and generic symptom patterns are not proof without configuration evidence.

zh.purpose: 通过查询真实区域配置、检查相关网络层、实施小范围修复并验证结果，诊断 Cloudflare 交付问题。
scenarios: 诊断重定向循环和 SSL/TLS 模式冲突。
调查 DNS、DNSSEC、证书、防火墙、负载均衡或源站错误。
在修改 Cloudflare 配置前检查当前状态。
zh.io: 输入为域名、Cloudflare 区域/账户访问权限、故障现象和源站信息；输出为配置证据、根因判断、可选 API 修改及修改后的验证结果。
dependencies: 具有适当权限的 API Token，或 Global API Key 加账户邮箱
curl 和 jq 等 JSON 解析工具
用于外部 DNS/TLS 检查的 dig 与 openssl
zh.boundary: 必须获得受影响 Cloudflare 账户的授权。调查应先保持只读；配置修改和缓存清除会影响线上交付。不得记录凭据，也不能仅凭常见症状断定根因。

grounding.scope: Cloudflare DNS, TLS, redirect, and origin diagnostics

en.purpose: Creates repeatable animated CLI demonstrations as GIFs using VHS tapes, with optional hidden setup, output filtering, timing control, speed adjustment, and frame verification.
scenarios: Record installation, build, test, or usage commands for README documentation.
Batch-generate several terminal demos from configuration.
Create self-resetting demos or manually controlled VHS tapes.
en.io: Inputs are shell commands, optional bootstrap/filter settings, visual dimensions/theme/timing, or batch YAML. Outputs are VHS tape files and rendered GIF demonstrations.
en.boundary: Records commands in a terminal environment and may execute them; callers must ensure the demonstrated commands are safe. VHS string parsing restricts certain shell characters, and visual correctness requires frame-level inspection rather than trusting successful rendering alone.

zh.purpose: 使用 VHS tape 创建可重复的 CLI 动画 GIF，并支持隐藏初始化、输出过滤、时序控制、加速和逐帧验证。
scenarios: 为 README 录制安装、构建、测试或使用流程。
从配置批量生成多个终端演示。
制作可自清理演示或手工精确控制的 VHS tape。
zh.io: 输入为 Shell 命令、可选初始化/过滤设置、画面尺寸、主题、时序或批量 YAML；输出为 VHS tape 文件和渲染后的 GIF。
dependencies: 交互录制可选依赖 asciinema
逐帧检查可选依赖 ffmpeg
批量 YAML 可选依赖 PyYAML
zh.boundary: 会在终端环境中录制并可能执行命令，调用者必须确认命令安全。VHS 字符串解析对部分 Shell 特殊字符有限制；渲染成功不代表视觉正确，仍需检查关键帧。

en.purpose: Guides creation, testing, registration, and diagnosis of Claude Code lifecycle hooks that enforce mechanically detectable rules at tool, session, or response boundaries.
scenarios: Block unsafe or repeatedly violated Bash/tool actions with PreToolUse guards.
Inject post-tool facts or check guard health at session start.
Build bounded Stop hooks and diagnose false blocks, bypasses, poisoned sessions, or registration drift.
en.io: Inputs are a recurring rule, Claude Code hook-event JSON, target tool/event, profile settings, and test cases. Outputs are hook scripts, test harnesses, registrations, audit records, and verified allow/block behavior.
dependencies: Claude settings files and hook directories
Bundled hook patterns and test harness
Optional macOS osascript for human confirmation gates
en.boundary: Only mechanically recognizable behavior is suitable for hooks. Incorrect PreToolUse hooks can disrupt all matching calls, and blocking hooks require explicit failure-direction and termination design. Hooks must be syntax-tested, exercised with real JSON, replayed against real command shapes, and registered per profile; prose rules and hooks are not interchangeable.

zh.purpose: 指导创建、测试、注册和诊断 Claude Code 生命周期钩子，在工具、会话或回复边界强制执行可机械识别的规则。
scenarios: 用 PreToolUse 守卫阻止不安全或反复违规的 Bash/工具操作。
在工具调用后注入事实，或在会话开始时检查守卫健康。
构建有界 Stop 钩子，并诊断误拦截、绕过、会话污染或配置漂移。
zh.io: 输入为反复出现的规则、Claude Code 钩子事件 JSON、目标工具/事件、配置文件和测试用例；输出为钩子脚本、测试工具、注册配置、审计记录及已验证的允许/拦截行为。
dependencies: Bash 与 Python 3 的 JSON/shlex 处理
Claude 设置文件和 hooks 目录
内置钩子模式与测试脚本
人工确认门可选依赖 macOS osascript
zh.boundary: 仅适用于可机械识别的行为。错误的 PreToolUse 钩子可能破坏所有匹配调用；阻塞钩子必须明确失败方向和终止设计。注册前需完成语法检查、真实 JSON 端到端测试和真实命令语料回放，并在各配置档注册；文字规则与钩子不可互相替代。

grounding.scope: Claude Code hook engineering and governance

en.purpose: Fetches current, citable Bilibili video metadata, creator information, per-part identifiers, engagement metrics, and danmaku, with an authenticated path for subtitles.
scenarios: Ingest a Bilibili video into a knowledge base with verified metadata.
Analyze performance using live view, like, coin, favorite, share, reply, and danmaku counts.
Retrieve part-specific danmaku or logged-in subtitle tracks.
en.io: Input is a BVID, av number, short link, full URL, and optional part/browser selection. Output is structured JSON metadata and metrics, danmaku text, or subtitle files.
dependencies: Browser cookies and yt-dlp for subtitles
en.boundary: Metrics are time-varying and must include fetched_at. Public metadata and danmaku need no login, but subtitles require the user's authenticated session and prior consent to read browser cookies. Missing data must not be estimated, and API behavior may drift.

zh.purpose: 获取可引用的 Bilibili 视频实时元数据、UP 主信息、分 P 标识、互动指标和弹幕，并提供需登录的字幕获取路径。
scenarios: 将 B 站视频以已核实元数据录入知识库。
利用播放、点赞、投币、收藏、分享、评论和弹幕数据分析表现。
获取指定分 P 的弹幕或登录态字幕轨道。
zh.io: 输入为 BVID、av 号、短链接、完整 URL，以及可选分 P/浏览器选择；输出为结构化元数据与指标 JSON、弹幕文本或字幕文件。
dependencies: curl 与 JSON/XML 处理工具
带适当请求头的网络访问
字幕所需的浏览器 Cookie 和 yt-dlp
zh.boundary: 指标会持续变化，必须附 fetched_at。公开元数据和弹幕无需登录，但字幕需要用户登录会话，读取浏览器 Cookie 前应取得同意。获取失败的数据不得估算，第三方 API 行为也可能变化。

grounding.scope: Bilibili video metadata, metrics, danmaku, and subtitle retrieval

en.purpose: Diagnoses and repairs repository setup, standardizes repeatable onboarding and startup behavior, and provides guarded Git workflows based on the repository's actual instructions and manifests.
scenarios: Repair a repository that does not build or run on a new machine.
Define a routine remote-sync or collaborator handoff.
Diagnose duplicate startup-hook output or perform guarded commit, push, conflict, or history-cleanup work.
en.io: Inputs are a repository path, project instructions, manifests, lockfiles, observed command failures, and the requested setup or Git outcome. Outputs are diagnostic evidence, minimal repairs, onboarding or agent instructions, optional hook configuration, and verification results.
dependencies: Python 3.10+ for the optional environment inventory
Claude Code settings only for Claude-specific startup hooks
Bundled setup, hook, and history-scan scripts
en.boundary: Diagnosis remains read-only until the cause and authorization are established. It must preserve local changes and must not auto-stash, merge, rebase, force, or overwrite work. Hooks are reserved for verified pre-prompt requirements; public pushes, force pushes, history rewrites, and destructive conflict choices require explicit approval.

zh.purpose: 依据仓库真实说明和清单诊断并修复开发环境，标准化可重复的交接与启动行为，并提供受约束的 Git 工作流。
scenarios: 修复在新机器上无法构建或运行的仓库。
定义日常远程同步或协作者交接流程。
诊断重复启动钩子输出，或安全处理提交、推送、冲突及历史清理。
zh.io: 输入为仓库路径、项目说明、清单与锁文件、实际命令错误和目标设置/Git 结果；输出为诊断证据、最小修复、上手文档或代理说明、可选钩子配置及验证结果。
dependencies: 可选环境检查所需的 Python 3.10+
仅 Claude 启动钩子所需的 Claude Code 配置
内置环境、钩子和历史扫描脚本
zh.boundary: 在明确原因和授权前保持只读。必须保护本地修改，不得自动 stash、merge、rebase、force 或覆盖工作。仅在确认必须首个提示前执行时使用钩子；公开推送、强推、历史重写及破坏性冲突处理需要明确批准。

grounding.scope: Repository environment setup, onboarding, hooks, and Git safety

en.purpose: Prepares audio or video for ASR and produces plain or speaker-labeled transcripts using a local Apple-Silicon pipeline, a remote API, or an optional Feishu Minutes upload path.
scenarios: Transcribe recordings, meetings, podcasts, lectures, or media URLs.
Merge recorder segments, normalize to 16 kHz mono, and optionally apply pitch-preserving speedup.
Generate speaker labels, word timestamps, voiceprint mappings, or an HTML transcript-audit page.
en.io: Inputs are local media files or URLs, preprocessing options, local/remote configuration, optional Hugging Face credentials, and output directories. Outputs include prepared audio, text/CSV transcripts, diarization and alignment JSON, word timing, manifests, audit HTML, or a Feishu minute URL.
dependencies: Apple Silicon plus MLX models for the local path
pyannote and a Hugging Face token for diarization
Optional remote ASR endpoint and network access
en.boundary: Local diarization/timing is platform- and credential-dependent; without it, output may be plain text. Remote services have format, size, duration, and timeout limits. Transcripts require truncation/alignment verification and may still contain recognition errors; transcript correction is a separate downstream function. Uploading to Feishu ends this workflow rather than also running local ASR.

zh.purpose: 为 ASR 预处理音频/视频，并通过 Apple Silicon 本地流水线、远程 API 或可选飞书妙记上传路径生成纯文本或带说话人标签的转写。
scenarios: 转写录音、会议、播客、讲座或媒体 URL。
合并录音机分段、统一为 16 kHz 单声道，并可选保音高加速。
生成说话人标签、词级时间戳、声纹映射或 HTML 转写审阅页。
zh.io: 输入为本地媒体文件或 URL、预处理选项、本地/远程配置、可选 Hugging Face 凭据和输出目录；输出包括预处理音频、文本/CSV 转写、说话人及对齐 JSON、词级时间、清单、审阅 HTML 或飞书妙记链接。
dependencies: 本地模式所需的 Apple Silicon 和 MLX 模型
说话人分离所需的 pyannote 与 Hugging Face Token
可选远程 ASR 端点和网络访问
上传飞书妙记可选依赖 lark-cli
可选 CAM++ 与 mlx-whisper 组件
zh.boundary: 本地说话人分离和时间对齐受平台及凭据限制，缺失时可能只能输出纯文本。远程服务存在格式、大小、时长和超时限制。转写需检查截断与对齐，仍可能含识别错误；纠错属于独立下游功能。选择上传飞书妙记后流程即结束，不再同时运行本地 ASR。

grounding.scope: Audio preprocessing, ASR transcription, diarization, alignment, and review

en.purpose: Initializes or refreshes a project's Hyperflow analysis cache, memory skeleton, checksums, and optional AI-tool detection shims without starting feature planning or implementation.
scenarios: Set up Hyperflow in a new project.
Refresh stale project analysis after configuration changes.
Install AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or provider-specific detection shims.
en.io: Inputs are a project repository and optional tool, force, or dry-run flags. Outputs are .hyperflow analysis and memory files, checksums/version markers, a gitignore entry, optional shims, and a creation/skip/migration summary.
dependencies: Parallel analysis agents for the described fresh-project workflow
en.boundary: Performs setup only and does not start the plan-to-dispatch chain. Existing learned memory should not be overwritten. Some derived memory files are owned by session-start scripts rather than scaffold, and missing Git or shim scripts causes documented degradation rather than inferred content.

zh.purpose: 初始化或刷新项目的 Hyperflow 分析缓存、记忆骨架、校验和及可选 AI 工具检测垫片，不启动功能规划或实现。
scenarios: 在新项目中初始化 Hyperflow。
配置变化后刷新过期的项目分析。
安装 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 或特定提供商的检测垫片。
zh.io: 输入为项目仓库及可选工具、force 或 dry-run 参数；输出为 .hyperflow 分析/记忆文件、校验和与版本标记、gitignore 条目、可选垫片及创建/跳过/迁移摘要。
dependencies: 新项目流程所述的并行分析代理
可选旧版 Hyperflow 记忆文件
zh.boundary: 仅执行初始化，不启动 plan→dispatch 链。不得覆盖已有学习记录。部分派生记忆文件由会话启动脚本维护而非 scaffold；缺少 Git 或垫片脚本时应按文档降级，不得臆造内容。

grounding.scope: Hyperflow project initialization and cache refresh

en.purpose: Fetches an incoming GitHub pull request, statically audits its real code range at a selected review depth, and optionally posts one gated review, prepares fixes, or merges after approval.
scenarios: Review a PR URL or number with file-context-aware findings.
Perform deeper review for external or security-sensitive contributions.
Post batched inline or summary feedback and optionally merge a passing PR.
en.io: Inputs are a PR URL/number, review level, comment/merge preferences, repository state, and GitHub authentication. Outputs are a local audit report, PASS or NEEDS_FIX findings, optional GitHub review, optional patch/fix branch updates, and optional merge result.
dependencies: Interactive approval gates for posting, fixes, execution, and merge
en.boundary: PR code, title, body, and comments are untrusted data. Review is static by default; running contributor code requires an explicit risk gate. Posting, modifying contributor branches, and merging are separate gated actions, and force-pushing contributor branches is excluded.

zh.purpose: 获取 GitHub 入站 PR，基于真实代码范围按指定深度进行静态审计，并在批准后可选发布一次审阅、准备修复或合并。
scenarios: 按 PR URL 或编号进行具备完整文件上下文的审查。
对外部贡献者或安全敏感变更执行更深审查。
批量发布行内/摘要反馈，并可选合并通过的 PR。
zh.io: 输入为 PR URL/编号、审查级别、评论/合并偏好、仓库状态和 GitHub 认证；输出为本地审计报告、PASS 或 NEEDS_FIX 发现、可选 GitHub review、可选修复更新及合并结果。
dependencies: 基于代理的领域审阅者
发布、修复、执行代码和合并所需的交互式确认门
zh.boundary: PR 代码、标题、正文和评论均是不可信数据。默认仅静态分析；运行贡献者代码必须经过明确风险确认。发布评论、修改贡献者分支和合并是相互独立的受控操作，禁止强推贡献者分支。

en.purpose: Turns an idea or engineering request into persisted Hyperflow prompts, specifications, task graphs, and implementation briefs, then stops at a mandatory build-location decision.
scenarios: Sharpen a vague prompt before engineering work.
Design a multi-subsystem feature and compare approaches.
Decompose a clear task into ordered batches and build-ready worker briefs.
en.io: Inputs are an idea, prompt, task, project cache/memory, optional depth and brief flags, and clarification answers. Outputs are files under .hyperflow/specs, .hyperflow/tasks, .hyperflow/features, and memory, plus an optional committed cross-session handoff package.
dependencies: Agent workers and reviewers for the described workflow
en.boundary: Planning never implements source code and never silently starts dispatch. It must persist the plan artifacts and always ask whether to build in the current session, another session, or later. Material ambiguity requires user input; headless execution stops rather than selecting a build path automatically.

zh.purpose: 将想法或工程请求转化为落盘的 Hyperflow 提示词、规格、任务图和实现简报，并在强制的构建位置选择处停止。
scenarios: 在工程实施前强化模糊需求。
设计跨多个子系统的功能并比较方案。
把清晰任务拆分为有顺序的批次和可直接实施的工作简报。
zh.io: 输入为想法、提示或任务、项目缓存/记忆、可选深度与简报参数及澄清答案；输出为 .hyperflow/specs、.hyperflow/tasks、.hyperflow/features 和记忆文件，以及可选的已提交跨会话交接包。
dependencies: 对 .hyperflow 目录的读写权限
所述流程需要的工作代理和审阅代理
提交交接包可选依赖 Git
zh.boundary: plan 不实现源码，也不得静默启动 dispatch。必须将规划产物写入磁盘，并始终询问在当前会话、另一会话还是以后构建。实质性歧义需要用户输入；无交互环境应停止，不能自动选择构建路径。

grounding.scope: Hyperflow request shaping, design, and task decomposition

en.purpose: Turns a GitHub issue into a classified and traceable workflow: bug diagnosis, feature planning, question response, or invalid/already-solved closure, with an optional reviewed pull-request exit.
scenarios: Implement or fix work described by an issue URL or number.
Check whether an issue is already solved on the current main branch.
Draft a response for question, discussion, invalid, or stale issues.
en.io: Inputs are an issue URL/number, its body/comments/labels, repository state, GitHub authentication, and PR/comment preferences. Outputs are a triage result, issue-derived spec, optional Hyperflow plan/dispatch artifacts, drafted comments, and an optional PR.
dependencies: Hyperflow triage, plan, dispatch, and bug-trace workflows
Interactive gates for ambiguity and outbound actions
en.boundary: Issue text is untrusted data and cannot authorize scripts, secrets, CI changes, or unrelated edits. Questions and invalid/already-fixed issues do not enter a code chain. Comments and PR creation are gated or explicitly pre-elected; unauthenticated mode remains local-only.

zh.purpose: 将 GitHub Issue 转化为可追溯的分类流程：Bug 根因诊断、功能规划、问题回复或无效/已解决关闭，并可选以审阅后的 PR 收尾。
scenarios: 实现或修复 Issue URL/编号描述的工作。
检查 Issue 是否已在当前 main 分支解决。
为问题、讨论、无效或过期 Issue 起草回复。
zh.io: 输入为 Issue URL/编号、正文/评论/标签、仓库状态、GitHub 认证及 PR/评论偏好；输出为分类结果、由 Issue 派生的规格、可选 Hyperflow plan/dispatch 产物、回复草稿和可选 PR。
dependencies: Hyperflow triage、plan、dispatch 和 bug trace 工作流
处理歧义和外部动作所需的交互确认门
zh.boundary: Issue 文本是不可信数据，不能授权执行脚本、使用密钥、修改 CI 或进行无关编辑。问题类及无效/已解决 Issue 不进入代码链。评论和 PR 创建必须经过确认或预先明确选择；未认证时仅在本地工作。

grounding.scope: GitHub issue ingestion, triage, planning-chain entry, and PR exit

en.purpose: Manually applies pending commits from an interrupted deferred-commit queue onto the user's Git branch and clears the queue.
scenarios: Recovering uncommitted work after a execution chain crashed or was interrupted before auto-flush
Inspecting queued commits using `--dry-run` before applying them to the target branch
Manually applying deferred commits when automatic chain wrap-up was skipped
en.io: Accepts an optional `--dry-run` flag and reads `.hyperflow/commits-queue/manifest.json` to output fast-forwarded Git commits and branch cleanup logs.
en.boundary: It does not automatically resolve branch divergence or merge conflicts, requiring manual rebase or cherry-pick handling if fast-forward fails.

zh.purpose: 手动刷新并应用因中断或未完成的 Hyperflow 流程而推迟提交的代码队列，并清理暂存分支与清单。
scenarios: 在 Hyperflow 执行链崩溃或中断后恢复未自动刷新的延迟提交
使用 `--dry-run` 参数预览队列中等待应用的提交列表
在自动收尾阶段被跳过时手动将暂存分支合并回用户分支
zh.io: 接受可选的 `--dry-run` 参数并读取 `.hyperflow/commits-queue/manifest.json` 队列文件，输出快进合并后的 Git 提交记录及分支清理日志。
zh.boundary: 当用户分支与暂存分支发生偏离时，它不会自动解决分支冲突，需用户手动执行 rebase 或 cherry-pick。

en.purpose: Orchestrates and dispatches parallel worker agents with per-batch reviewer oversight to execute multi-step plans from task files and commit completed sub-tasks.
scenarios: Executing structured task plans from `.hyperflow/tasks/` with fan-out worker agents
Running multi-level code reviews and quality gate checks on batch outputs
Synthesizing batch learnings and creating per-subtask Git commits automatically
en.io: Inputs task file paths, handoff slugs, and execution flags; outputs code modifications, Git commits, and final integration review summaries.
en.boundary: Executes tasks and commits code locally, but does NOT perform automated deployment or release operations.

zh.purpose: 调度并编排并行 Worker Agent，在按批次审查员的监督下执行任务文件中的多步骤计划并提交子任务代码。
scenarios: 使用并行 Worker Agent 执行来自 `.hyperflow/tasks/` 的结构化任务计划
对批次产出运行多级代码审查与自动化质量门禁检查
合成批次执行经验并自动针对每个子任务创建 Git 提交
zh.io: 输入任务文件路径、handoff 标识及执行参数标志，输出代码修改、Git 提交记录和最终集成审查总结。
zh.boundary: 负责任务的分派执行、代码审查与本地提交，但明确不包含自动部署或线上发布功能。

en.purpose: Executes a rigorous pre-push release pipeline that runs linting, typechecking, builds, tests, and security sweeps before committing and pushing code.
scenarios: Preparing and releasing a new package or application version
Running automated pre-push security and quality validation gates
Safely committing and pushing staged changes with explicit user confirmation
en.io: Accepts release or deployment triggers (e.g., '/hyperflow:deploy' or 'ship it') and outputs step-by-step validation results and push confirmations.
en.boundary: It does not auto-fix failing quality or security checks, never uses '--no-verify' to bypass gates, and will not push code without explicit user confirmation.

zh.purpose: 在提交和推送代码之前，执行包含代码检查、类型检查、构建、测试及安全扫描的严格发布前流水线。
scenarios: 准备并发布新的软件包或应用版本
在推送前运行自动化的质量与安全验证门禁
在获得用户明确确认后，安全地提交并推送变更
zh.io: 接收发布或部署触发指令（如 '/hyperflow:deploy' 或 'ship it'），输出各阶段验证门禁的执行结果与推送状态。
zh.boundary: 该技能不会自动修复失败的质量或安全检查，绝不使用 '--no-verify' 跳过门禁，且在未经用户明确确认前不会执行推送。

en.purpose: Provides a comprehensive CRUD interface to manage persistent project memory stored within the `.hyperflow/memory/` directory.
scenarios: Searching past project decisions, learnings, and coding conventions
Adding new insights or editing existing memory entries during development
Pruning, archiving, or compacting stale memory files to maintain project context
Migrating legacy memory entries or viewing storage statistics
en.io: Accepts memory subcommands and context details as input, and outputs memory entries, search results, or action confirmation summaries.
en.boundary: Only reads and modifies files inside `.hyperflow/memory/` and never directly edits project source code files.

zh.purpose: 提供用于管理 `.hyperflow/memory/` 目录下项目持久化记忆的全套 CRUD 接口。
scenarios: 检索项目以往的决策记录、经验教训与开发规范
在开发过程中添加新心得或修改已有的记忆条目
对陈旧记忆进行清理、归档或压缩以维持高效上下文
迁移旧版记忆文件或查看当前记忆库的统计信息
zh.io: 输入为记忆管理子命令及相关参数，输出为格式化的记忆条目、搜索结果或操作状态汇总。
zh.boundary: 仅对 `.hyperflow/memory/` 目录下的记忆文件进行读写，绝不直接修改项目的源代码文件。

en.purpose: Embeds a portable subset of hyperflow's behavioral rules into a project's CLAUDE.md file so they take effect across non-CLI surfaces like Claude Desktop and claude.ai web.
scenarios: Applying hyperflow workflow rules to Claude Desktop or claude.ai web sessions.
Updating or refreshing the managed hyperflow doctrine block inside CLAUDE.md.
Configuring auto-bridge settings or removing the doctrine block from the project.
en.io: Accepts subcommand arguments (generate, refresh, remove, status, mode) and manages fenced doctrine blocks in CLAUDE.md along with project bridge mode settings.
en.boundary: It only embeds static behavioral guidelines into CLAUDE.md and cannot execute slash commands or dispatch dynamic skills outside the CLI.

zh.purpose: 将 hyperflow 的行为准则精简版嵌入项目的 CLAUDE.md 文件中，使其能够在 Claude Desktop 和 claude.ai 网页等非 CLI 环境中生效。
scenarios: 使 hyperflow 行为规范在 Claude Desktop 或 claude.ai 网页端生效。
在插件更新后手动或自动刷新 CLAUDE.md 中的准则区块。
管理项目的自动桥接模式或从 CLAUDE.md 中移除准则内容。
zh.io: 接收子命令参数（generate、refresh、remove、status、mode），并在 CLAUDE.md 和 `.hyperflow/.bridge-mode` 文件中写入或查看准则与模式状态。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅能在 CLAUDE.md 中嵌入静态准则文本，无法在 CLI 之外触发斜杠命令或进行实际的动态技能调度。

en.purpose: Manages, inspects, cancels, and cleans up background agents and their output buffers generated by Hyperflow workflows.
scenarios: Listing all active, completed, or stalled background agents
Inspecting the output log of a completed background task
Canceling running background agents before ending a session
Pruning old output buffer files older than 7 days
en.io: Takes subcommands like list, show, cancel, or prune along with optional IDs as input, and outputs task status tables, log contents, or status updates.
en.boundary: It only manages state and logs of existing background processes and does not spawn new agents or execute workflow steps directly.

zh.purpose: 用于管理、查看、取消和清理 Hyperflow 工作流产生的后台 Agent 及其输出日志。
scenarios: 查看所有运行中、已完成或挂起的后台 Agent 列表
检查特定已完成后台任务的详细日志输出
在结束会话前取消正在运行的后台 Agent
清理保存超过 7 天的历史输出缓冲区文件
zh.io: 输入子命令（如 list、show、cancel、prune）及可选的任务 ID，输出任务状态表格、日志内容或状态更新提示。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅负责管理已有后台进程的状态和日志，本身不会主动创建新的后台 Agent 或直接执行工作流逻辑。

en.purpose: Performs multi-level (L1-L5) code reviews on recent changes to evaluate code quality, specification compliance, security, and performance.
scenarios: Reviewing git diffs or pull requests prior to merging
Auditing recent changes for security vulnerabilities and performance bottlenecks
Checking code quality against project conventions and test coverage patterns
en.io: Accepts target files, git references, or review level flags (L1-L5) as inputs, and outputs categorized review findings along with an interactive fix prompt.
en.boundary: It analyzes code and synthesizes review findings without modifying files directly, delegating actual code fixes to downstream workflows upon user approval at the fix gate.

zh.purpose: 对近期代码变更进行多层级（L1-L5）代码审查，全面评估代码质量、规范符合度、安全性与性能。
scenarios: 在代码合并前审查 Git Diff 或 PR 变更
审计近期代码中的安全漏洞与性能瓶颈
依据项目规范与测试覆盖模式评估代码质量
zh.io: 输入目标文件、Git 引用或审查层级（L1-L5），输出分类化的审查报告及交互式修复提示。
zh.boundary: 仅负责分析代码与汇总审查意见，本身不会直接修改文件，需在用户通过修复关卡确认后交由后续工作流执行代码修复。

en.purpose: Provides a browser automation CLI for AI agents to programmatically interact with websites, perform UI actions, and extract web content.
scenarios: Automating login flows and complex multi-step form submissions
Scraping dynamic web pages and taking page screenshots
Testing web applications by clicking buttons and asserting page state
Downloading files and inspecting DOM element text
en.io: Takes CLI commands and element references (e.g., '@e1') as input, and outputs element snapshots, text content, screenshots, or downloaded files.
en.boundary: It strictly operates through browser CLI execution and does not handle anti-bot CAPTCHA bypassing or non-browser API calls.

zh.purpose: 为 AI Agent 提供基于命令行（CLI）的浏览器自动化工具，用于程序化地与网页交互、执行操作及提取数据。
scenarios: 自动化执行登录流程与复杂的多步骤网页表单填写
抓取动态网页内容与保存页面屏幕截图
通过点击按键和断言页面状态对 Web 应用进行自动化测试
触发文件下载与检查 DOM 元素文本
zh.io: 输入为 CLI 浏览器控制指令和元素引用标识（如 '@e1'），输出为元素快照、网页文本、截图或下载的文件。
zh.boundary: 该工具仅限于通过 CLI 执行浏览器操作，不具备绕过人机验证（CAPTCHA）或处理非浏览器 API 请求的能力。

en.purpose: Transforms a Notion Tasks database into a source-of-truth dispatch board to manage, orchestrate, and batch-execute AI agency workflows using specialized models.
scenarios: Capturing chat discussions and adding them as task suggestions into Notion
Discussing, approving, and transitioning tasks through status workflows
Batch-executing approved To-Do tasks across parallel agents with per-task model selection
Managing subtask trees, task dependencies, and recurring cadences in Notion
en.io: Inputs CLI subcommands or conversational chat triggers alongside Notion workspace state, and outputs updated Notion database entries, state transitions, and task execution results.
en.boundary: It operates strictly through Notion as its stateless single source of truth and does not maintain local disk state or support non-Notion task management boards.

zh.purpose: 将 Notion 任务数据库打造为单一事实来源的分发看板，用于跨不同模型管理、编排和批量并行执行 AI Agency 工作流。
scenarios: 将对话讨论内容捕获并作为任务建议添加至 Notion
在状态工作流中讨论、审批和推进任务状态
通过并行 Agent 及按任务指定的模型批量执行待办任务
在 Notion 中管理子任务树、任务依赖关系及周期性任务
zh.io: 输入 CLI 子命令或自然语言对话指令以及 Notion 工作区状态，输出更新后的 Notion 数据库条目、状态迁移及任务执行结果。
zh.boundary: 该技能完全依赖 Notion 作为无状态的单一事实来源，不在本地磁盘持久化运行状态，也不支持第三方看板或非 Notion 任务管理工具。

en.purpose: Guides the AI agent to execute tasks autonomously end-to-end without stopping for step-by-step user permission or guidance.
scenarios: Executing complex multi-step code refactoring without prompting for confirmation after every minor change.
Resolving secondary issues encountered during task execution independently to deliver a fully functional output.
Handling end-to-end project updates based on high-level goals without needing hand-holding.
en.io: Inputs high-level user directives or goals, and outputs completely finished, validated task results.
en.boundary: It does not grant permission to make unrecoverable destructive system changes or violate core project safety constraints.

zh.purpose: 指导 AI Agent 端到端地自主完成任务，避免在每个微小步骤中频繁寻求用户确认或指导。
scenarios: 在无需每步确认的情况下，自主完成多步骤的代码重构与功能开发。
自动识别并修复执行过程中发现的衍生问题，直接交付最终可用的结果。
根据高层级目标主动推进关联任务，无需用户全程步步跟进。
zh.io: 输入为高层级的任务目标或指令，输出为完整交付且验证通过的最终结果。
zh.boundary: 本技能不包含执行未授权的破坏性系统变更或突破核心安全限制的行为。

en.purpose: Guides the step-by-step creation of a reusable agent-integration skill that synthesizes official OpenAI SDK, LiteLLM, and FastMCP documentation for connecting custom LLM backends.
scenarios: Configuring LiteLLM proxy and custom base_url endpoints to route OpenAI SDK calls to custom LLM deployments like Ollama.
Implementing structured outputs and tool calling patterns for self-hosted or alternative model backends.
Setting up Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with error handling and foundation model fallbacks.
en.io: Inputs documentation research prompts and framework configurations; outputs a verified agent-integration skill file saved in .claude/skills/.
en.boundary: Focuses on synthesizing documentation into reusable skill patterns and templates, and does not build or run end-to-end agent applications directly.

zh.purpose: 指导通过检索 OpenAI SDK、LiteLLM 和 FastMCP 官方文档来创建可复用的 Agent 集成 Skill，以连接自定义 LLM 后端与 Agent 框架。
scenarios: 配置 LiteLLM 代理和自定义 base_url，将 OpenAI SDK 请求重定向至 Ollama 等本地大模型后端。
为自定义模型实现结构化输出和工具调用（Tool Calling）集成模式。
搭建 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 服务端并配置异常降级回退机制。
zh.io: 输入文档检索需求与框架配置要求，输出存储在 .claude/skills/ 目录下的 Agent 集成 Skill 文件。
zh.boundary: 仅专注于将官方文档提炼为可复用的集成模式 Skill 与配置模板，不负责直接运行或部署完整的 Agent 业务系统。

en.purpose: Guides the composition, acceptance testing, and commercial positioning required to build production-ready, specification-first Digital FTE agent skills.
scenarios: Writing domain-specific design specifications (spec.md) for custom agent skills
Orchestrating multiple MCP-wrapping and script-execution skills into a cohesive architecture
Running acceptance test scenarios to validate edge cases, error handling, and specification alignment
Formulating monetization and go-to-market strategies for standalone agent products
en.io: Takes domain business requirements and sub-component skills as input, and outputs a specification-driven, fully validated Digital FTE skill package along with a monetization plan.
en.boundary: It focuses on skill composition methodology, spec validation, and business strategy rather than providing an automated no-code skill generator or direct agent runtime hosting.

zh.purpose: 指导开发者遵循规范优先原则组合多个子技能，构建、验证并商业化可投产的数字员工（Digital FTE）代理技能。
scenarios: 编写特定领域代理技能的设计规范（spec.md）与验收标准
将多个 MCP 工具和脚本执行技能整合为统一的数字员工架构
设计并执行验收测试用例，验证边缘情况与容错恢复机制
制定打包代理技能的商业定位、定价模型与 Go-To-Market 策略
zh.io: 输入业务需求及已有的子组件技能，输出包含规范文档、测试报告和商业化规划的完整数字员工技能包。
zh.boundary: 本技能侧重于架构组合方法论、规范验证与商业策略规划，不提供自动化的无代码技能生成工具或运行时 Agent 托管平台。

en.purpose: Teaches how to create an agent skill that uses a write-execute-analyze loop with automated error recovery to autonomously process data.
scenarios: Building autonomous CSV analysis workflows with automatic edge-case handling.
Implementing automated code execution and self-healing error recovery in agents.
Creating robust data processing pipelines with defined iteration and timeout controls.
en.io: Inputs data specifications, raw data files, and success criteria; outputs validated execution results, processed data, and execution logs.
en.boundary: Focuses on automated iterative script execution and recovery within a sandbox, but does not cover production application deployment or interactive UI building.

zh.purpose: 教授如何构建一个通过“编写-执行-分析”循环和自动错误修复机制来自主处理数据的 Agent 技能。
scenarios: 构建能够自动处理边界情况的 CSV 数据分析工作流。
为 Agent 实现自动代码执行与自我修复机制。
创建具备收敛判定和超时控制的稳健数据处理流水线。
zh.io: 输入数据处理规范、原始数据文件和收敛标准，输出经过校验的执行结果、处理完的数据以及运行日志。
zh.boundary: 专注于沙盒环境中的自动化迭代脚本执行与错误恢复，不涉及生产级应用部署或交互式 UI 开发。

en.purpose: Guides users to generate a customized Claude Agent SDK skill using natural language prompts and official documentation.
scenarios: Generating a baseline Claude Agent SDK skill from official documentation
Configuring agent tool patterns, subagents, and hooks via natural conversation
Bootstrapping agentic AI development setups in local projects
en.io: Accepts user prompt preferences as input and outputs a structured Claude Agent SDK skill directory inside .claude/skills/.
en.boundary: It focuses on generating and bootstrapping the Claude Agent SDK skill, but does not directly execute or deploy production agent services.

zh.purpose: 指导用户利用自然语言提示词和官方文档快速生成自定义的 Claude Agent SDK 技能。
scenarios: 结合官方最新文档快速生成 Claude Agent SDK 基础技能
通过自然对话配置 Agent 的工具模式、子代理及钩子函数
在本地开发环境中初始化并引导智能体开发工作流
zh.io: 输入用户的 Agent SDK 技能定制需求，输出生成在 .claude/skills/ 目录下的结构化技能文件。
zh.boundary: 仅负责 Agent SDK 技能模板的创建与初始化，不直接执行、托管或部署生产环境中的智能体服务。

en.purpose: Teaches users how to bootstrap a Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) skill for Claude using official documentation.
scenarios: Generating a Google ADK skill via a single prompt in Claude Code
Fetching official Gemini ADK documentation via Context7 for skill creation
Setting up standard ADK skill templates in .claude/skills/
en.io: Inputs a natural language prompt instructing Claude to build the skill; outputs a generated Google ADK skill directory in .claude/skills/.
en.boundary: This file provides instructions for bootstrapping an ADK skill from documentation, but does not directly execute code or deploy production agents.

zh.purpose: 教导用户如何利用官方文档在 Claude 中快速创建并引导配置谷歌 Agent 开发工具包（ADK）技能。
scenarios: 在 Claude Code 中通过单条提示词快速生成 Google ADK 技能
通过 Context7 获取 Gemini ADK 官方文档以构建定制技能
在 .claude/skills/ 目录中建立标准的 ADK 技能模板
zh.io: 输入用于触发技能创建的自然语言提示词；输出在 .claude/skills/ 目录下生成的 Google ADK 技能目录。
zh.boundary: 该教程仅提供引导生成 ADK 技能的指令，不直接执行代码或部署生产级 Agent 系统。

en.purpose: Guides users through bootstrapping a custom OpenAI Agents SDK skill for Claude Code by leveraging official documentation via Context7.
scenarios: Generating an OpenAI Agents SDK skill inside Claude Code using a single prompt.
Fetching up-to-date official OpenAI documentation to build an accurate agent skill.
Bootstrapping a learning workspace for building AI agents from basic to production level.
en.io: Inputs user instructions to create the skill via prompt, and outputs generated skill files in the `.claude/skills/openai-agents/` directory.
en.boundary: It only scaffolds the OpenAI Agents skill template using official docs and does not directly write or execute full production agent backend code.

zh.purpose: 指导用户利用 Context7 调取官方文档，为 Claude Code 快速生成自定义的 OpenAI Agents SDK 技能。
scenarios: 通过一条提示词在 Claude Code 中生成 OpenAI Agents SDK 技能。
抓取最新的 OpenAI 官方文档以构建无盲区假设的 Agent 技能库。
搭建从入门到生产级的智能体开发学习与脚手架环境。
zh.io: 输入为要求创建技能提示词指令，输出为存储在 `.claude/skills/openai-agents/` 目录下的技能配置文件。
zh.boundary: 该过程仅负责引导生成技能脚手架与知识库，并不直接编写或运行具体的生产级多智能体应用代码。

en.purpose: Guides users to build a custom OpenAI Agents SDK skill using natural language prompts and official documentation.
scenarios: Generating an OpenAI Agents skill using Claude's skill creator.
Fetching up-to-date OpenAI documentation via Context7 to generate accurate code patterns.
Creating a base skill template for building multi-agent workflows.
en.io: Takes prompt instructions and official OpenAI documentation context as input, and outputs a created skill folder at .claude/skills/openai-agents/.
en.boundary: This skill guides the creation and setup of the agent skill template, but does not directly execute or deploy production agent runtime code.

zh.purpose: 指导用户通过自然语言提示词和官方文档构建自定义的 OpenAI Agents SDK 技能。
scenarios: 使用 Claude 的技能创建工具自动生成 OpenAI Agents 技能框架。
通过 Context7 获取最新的 OpenAI 官方文档以生成准确的代码模式。
建立用于构建多智能体工作流的基础技能模板。
zh.io: 输入为自然语言指令与 OpenAI 官方文档上下文，输出为在 .claude/skills/openai-agents/ 目录下生成的技能文件夹。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅用于引导生成技能模板与结构，本身并不直接运行或部署生产环境的 Agent 代码。

en.purpose: Validates system auto-boot sequences using lightweight Bash scripts and Git-based memory persistence.
scenarios: Validating system auto-boot sequences during startup
Testing boot routines under offline or degraded execution scenarios
Tracking boot state diagnostics and history using Git as a persistence layer
en.io: Accepts boot configurations or environment triggers as input and returns validation status reports and diagnostic logs.
en.boundary: It only performs auto-boot sequence validation and diagnostic logging, without providing operating system installation or multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning.

zh.purpose: 通过原生 Bash 脚本和基于 Git 的记忆持久化层校验 Trinity 系统的自动启动序列。
scenarios: 在系统启动期间验证自动启动流程与逻辑
在离线或降级环境下测试启动流程的边界情况
利用 Git 记录并追踪启动状态历史与故障诊断
zh.io: 接收启动配置或环境触发信号作为输入，输出校验状态报告及故障诊断日志。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅专注于自动启动序列的校验与状态诊断，不涵盖操作系统部署或复杂的云端基础设施管理。

en.purpose: Validates Trinity auto-boot sequences automatically using bash-native scripts and git-based state persistence.
scenarios: Validating auto-boot sequences during system startup or recovery.
Testing system resilience and boot integrity under degraded or offline conditions.
Tracking autopoietic feedback loops and validation logs using Git as a database.
en.io: Takes system boot triggers and configurations as inputs and outputs validation status results and Git persistence records.
en.boundary: Focuses solely on boot sequence verification and state tracking, and does not perform physical system installation or hardware repair.

zh.purpose: 使用原生 Bash 脚本与基于 Git 的状态持久化机制自动验证 Trinity 自动引导流程。
scenarios: 在系统启动或恢复阶段验证自动引导序列。
在离线或服务降级环境下测试系统的引导韧性与状态完整性。
利用 Git 记录自生反馈循环与引导验证日志。
zh.io: 输入系统引导触发指令与配置参数，输出验证状态结果及存入 Git 的状态记录。
zh.boundary: 仅专注于引导序列校验与状态记录，不负责系统重装或硬件级别的修缮。

en.purpose: Find, map, and scrape state-by-state criminal record expungement laws and authoritative court sources reflecting the 2026 legal landscape.
scenarios: Locating primary authoritative court and statutory URLs for state expungement laws
Configuring Firecrawl web scrapers for state legislature and court self-help sites
Researching recent state updates regarding Clean Slate acts and marijuana record expungements
en.io: Inputs state names, legal research requests, or scraping parameters, and outputs structured Firecrawl configurations, authoritative URL hierarchies, and coverage gap assessments.
en.boundary: This skill does not interpret legal statutory meaning, offer legal advice, build UI components, or perform general non-legal web scraping.

zh.purpose: 查找、梳理并抓取各州犯罪记录涂销法律及权威法院资源，反映2026年的最新法律动态。
scenarios: 定位各州记录涂销法律的权威法院与立法机关原发 URL
为州立法机关和法院自助服务网站配置 Firecrawl 网页抓取任务
调研各州关于“洁面法案”（Clean Slate）及大麻记录涂销的最新法律变动
zh.io: 输入州名称、法律调研需求或抓取参数，输出结构化的 Firecrawl 配置、权威 URL 拓扑结构及数据覆盖缺口评估。
zh.boundary: 该技能不负责解释法律条文的具体含义、提供法律咨询建议、构建前端 UI 组件，或进行与法律无关的通用网页抓取。

en.purpose: Interactively generates or updates a comprehensive AGENTS.md file for Java repositories to establish tech stacks, workflows, and AI agent boundaries.
scenarios: Creating a new AGENTS.md file for a Java project from scratch
Updating existing agent guidelines and project conventions in a repository
Establishing clear permission boundaries (Always do / Ask first / Never do) for AI collaborators
en.io: Inputs user input from interactive prompts and repository file context, and outputs a formatted AGENTS.md markdown file.
en.boundary: It generates documentation and agent guidelines, but does not execute project build commands or modify actual source code files.

zh.purpose: 通过模块化交互流程为 Java 项目生成或更新 AGENTS.md 指南文件，以规范 AI Agent 的技术栈、工作流及行为边界。
scenarios: 从零开始为 Java 项目创建全新的 AGENTS.md 文件
更新现有仓库中的 AI Agent 操作指南、命令行规范与 Git 工作流
为 AI 协作者设定明确的执行权限边界（始终执行 / 提前询问 / 严禁执行）
zh.io: 输入用户交互提示的回答与仓库文件上下文，输出结构化的 AGENTS.md 文档。
zh.boundary: 仅专注于引导互动与生成 Agent 规范文档，不执行项目构建部署命令或修改项目的实际源代码。

en.purpose: Interactively installs embedded robot agent definitions into either the .cursor/agents or .claude/agents directory.
scenarios: Bootstrapping the .cursor/agents directory with standard agent definitions
Setting up the .claude/agents directory for Claude Code usage
Re-installing or updating embedded agent definition files in a project
en.io: Takes the user's interactive target directory selection as input and outputs copied agent files into the destination along with a summary report.
en.boundary: This skill strictly handles copying predefined agent files to the selected directory and does not configure agent logic or modify other project files.

zh.purpose: 通过交互方式引导用户选择目标路径，将预定义的嵌入式 Agent 配置文件安装至 .cursor/agents 或 .claude/agents 目录。
scenarios: 在项目中初始化 .cursor/agents 目录下的 Agent 配置文件
为 Claude Code 环境配置 .claude/agents 目录及其 Agent 定义
重新安装或更新项目中的 Agent 配置文件
zh.io: 输入用户的目标路径选择，输出复制到指定目录的 Agent 配置文件以及安装结果报告。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 仅负责将预定义的 Agent 文件复制到指定目录，不包含对 Agent 逻辑的修改或对其他项目文件的调整。

en.purpose: Update skill documentation and templates to require AI agents to use their real identities in worklogs.
scenarios: Updating worklog templates to remove hardcoded agent identity placeholders
Establishing guidelines for maintaining accurate audit logs in agent tasks
Revising skill conventions to enforce identity compliance
en.io: Inputs documentation files and templates; outputs updated skill rules and non-hardcoded templates.
en.boundary: Does not enforce agent identity checking via code or automated script logic.

zh.purpose: 更新技能文档与模板，要求 AI Agent 在工作日志中使用真实的 Agent 身份。
scenarios: 更新工作日志模板以移除硬编码的 Agent 身份占位符
建立规范以确保 Agent 任务审计日志的真实性与准确性
修订技能约定文件以强调身份使用规则
zh.io: 输入为现有文档与模板文件，输出为包含最新身份规范的文档与动态模板。
zh.boundary: 不包含在脚本或代码层面上对 Agent 身份进行的自动化技术强制校验。

en.purpose: Provides a toolset to build, develop, and bundle complex multi-component React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui web applications into a single self-contained HTML artifact for Claude.ai.
scenarios: Building interactive web applications or dashboards requiring complex state management and routing
Developing modern UI interfaces that leverage shadcn/ui component libraries
Bundling multi-file frontend React projects into a single inline HTML file for user presentation
en.io: Inputs: Project configuration commands and React frontend component code; Outputs: A single bundled, self-contained HTML file (bundle.html).
en.boundary: This skill is specifically designed for complex, multi-component web projects and should not be used for generating simple, single-file HTML or basic JSX snippets.

zh.purpose: 提供一套工具流，用于将基于 React、Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 的复杂多组件 Web 应用构建并打包为单个自包含的 Claude.ai HTML Artifact。
scenarios: 构建需要复杂状态管理或路由逻辑的交互式 Web 应用或仪表板
使用 shadcn/ui 组件库开发现代化的前端 UI 界面
将多文件 React 前端项目打包合并为一个可直接在对话中展示的独立 HTML 文件
zh.io: 输入：项目配置指令与 React 前端组件代码；输出：打包好的单个自包含 HTML 文件（bundle.html）。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 专为复杂的多组件 Web 应用设计，不适用于生成简单的单文件 HTML 或基础 JSX 片段。

en.purpose: Apply curated or custom visual themes, including cohesive color palettes and font pairings, to artifacts such as presentation slides, documents, and HTML pages.
scenarios: Styling presentation slide decks or reports using pre-set professional themes
Displaying theme choices via a showcase PDF to gather user preferences
Generating a custom color and font theme on-the-fly based on specific user requirements
en.io: Takes an existing artifact along with a chosen theme name or custom visual description as input, and outputs the artifact styled with matching colors and fonts.
