en.boundary: This skill only manages visual styling through fonts and hex color application, and does not generate or edit the underlying content of the artifact.

zh.purpose: 为演示文稿、文档及网页等产出物应用精心设计的预设主题或自定义视觉主题（含配色方案与字体搭配）。
scenarios: 使用预设的专业主题对演示文稿或报告进行美化与样式统一
通过展示 PDF 文件向用户呈现多种主题样式并获取选择确认
根据用户的具体描述即时生成自定义的配色与字体组合主题
zh.io: 输入为待样式的产出物以及选定的主题名称或自定义描述，输出应用了相应字体和配色方案的产出物。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 仅负责配色和字体样式的选择与应用，不承担产出物具体内容的生成或撰写。

en.purpose: Provides guidelines and Python utilities for drawing, building, and optimizing animated GIFs specifically formatted for Slack emojis and messages.
scenarios: Generating custom animated Slack emoji GIFs from scratch using code or drawing primitives
Animating uploaded user images for use in Slack messages
Validating and compressing existing GIF files to meet Slack file size and parameter constraints
en.io: Inputs user animation prompts, design parameters, or optional base images, and outputs optimized, Slack-ready GIF files.
en.boundary: Does not support video file processing, audio editing, or non-GIF media output formats.

zh.purpose: 提供用于绘制、构建及优化专为 Slack 表情和消息设计的动态 GIF 的 Python 工具包与指南。
scenarios: 通过代码与绘制图元从零生成自定义的 Slack 动态表情 GIF
将用户上传的图片转换为适合 Slack 消息发送的动态 GIF
对已有的 GIF 文件进行校验与压缩，使其符合 Slack 的文件大小和参数限制
zh.io: 输入用户的动画描述指令、配置参数或可选参考图片，输出经过优化的 Slack 专用 GIF 文件。
zh.boundary: 不支持视频文件处理、音频剪辑以及 GIF 之外的其他非图像媒体格式输出。

en.purpose: Helps users create, iteratively refine, evaluate, benchmark, and trigger-optimize Claude agent skills from scratch or existing workflows.
scenarios: Creating a new agent skill from a user request or conversation history
Running qualitative and quantitative evaluations on test prompts to benchmark performance
Iteratively updating skill prompt instructions based on user evaluation feedback
Optimizing skill descriptions to improve automated triggering accuracy
en.io: Accepts skill requirements, existing workflow logs, or draft skill files, and outputs structured SKILL.md files, test cases, and evaluation reports.
en.boundary: It focuses on skill prompt design, benchmarking, and description optimization, but does not handle production deployment or external runtime hosting.

zh.purpose: 帮助用户从零创建、迭代修改、评估测试以及优化 Claude Agent 技能及其触发描述。
scenarios: 根据用户需求或历史对话记录从头创建全新的技能
使用测试提示词运行定性与定量评估以测试技能效果
根据用户评估反馈或基准测试结果迭代重写现有的技能文件
优化技能描述文本以提高 Agent 自动调用的准确率
zh.io: 输入用户的技能需求、对话工作流或技能草稿，输出结构化的 SKILL.md 文件、测试用例和评估报告。
zh.boundary: 本技能仅负责技能文件的编写、基准测试与描述优化，不负责技能在生产环境的上线部署或运维托管。

en.purpose: A comprehensive skill for creating, reading, editing, and converting PowerPoint presentation files (.pptx and .potx).
scenarios: Generating new slide decks programmatically using pptxgenjs
Extracting text content and generating Markdown summaries from existing presentations
Editing existing slides, templates, and layouts via XML manipulation and package validation
Converting PPTX files to PDF or generating visual thumbnail grids for slide selection
en.io: Inputs include .pptx or .potx files, template structures, or creation parameters; outputs are generated/updated presentation files, extracted Markdown text, or converted PDF documents.
en.boundary: This skill does not provide a visual interactive GUI for slide editing, support live presentation broadcasting, or handle non-presentation document formats.

zh.purpose: 用于创建、读取、修改和转换 PowerPoint 演示文稿文件（.pptx 与 .potx）的综合技能。
scenarios: 使用 pptxgenjs 编写脚本以编程方式生成全新的 PPT 幻灯片
使用 markitdown 从现有演示文稿中提取文本并生成 Markdown 概要
通过解包修改 XML 源码来编辑现有的幻灯片、版式或模板并完成结构校验
将 PPTX 文件转换为 PDF 格式或生成用于布局挑选的缩略图网格
zh.io: 输入包括 .pptx/.potx 文件、模板或创建参数；输出为生成/修改后的演示文稿文件、提取的 Markdown 文本或转换后的 PDF 文档。
zh.boundary: 该技能不提供可视化的交互式幻灯片编辑界面，不支持实时演示播放，也不处理非演示文稿类文档格式。

en.purpose: Provides programmatic methods and instructions for reading, creating, manipulating, and extracting content from PDF documents.
scenarios: Extracting text or structured tables from PDF files into formats like Excel or plain text.
Merging multiple PDF documents together or splitting a PDF into separate page files.
Generating new custom PDF reports and documents programmatically.
Rotating pages, filling out form fields, or performing OCR on scanned PDFs.
en.io: Accepts PDF files, form inputs, or raw text/data, and outputs extracted text, structured data files (e.g., XLSX), or modified/new PDF documents.
en.boundary: Does not support direct editing of complex pre-existing visual graphics or converting non-PDF document formats without external conversion tools.

zh.purpose: 提供用于读取、创建、处理以及从 PDF 文档中提取内容的自动化方法与指南。
scenarios: 从 PDF 文件中提取文本或结构化表格并导出为 Excel 或纯文本。
将多个 PDF 文档合并为一个文件，或将单个 PDF 拆分为独立页面。
通过代码程序化生成全新的自定义 PDF 报告和文档。
旋转 PDF 页面、填写表单内容或对扫描件进行 OCR 识别。
zh.io: 接收 PDF 文件、表单输入或原始文本/数据，输出提取的文本、结构化数据文件（如 XLSX）或修改/新生成的 PDF 文档。
zh.boundary: 不支持直接对已有 PDF 进行复杂的矢量图形可视化编辑，也不直接支持非 PDF 格式的文档转换（除非依赖外部转换工具）。

en.purpose: Guide developers in planning and building high-quality Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in TypeScript or Python to enable LLMs to interact with external APIs.
scenarios: Planning tool definitions and API coverage for a new MCP server integration.
Selecting appropriate transport protocols and context management patterns for MCP development.
Generating MCP server implementation code following official TypeScript or Python SDK best practices.
en.io: Takes service API specifications and integration requirements as input, and outputs structured MCP server architecture plans, tool designs, and code patterns.
en.boundary: Provides architecture and implementation guidance for building MCP servers, but does not directly deploy, host, or execute server instances.

zh.purpose: 指导开发人员使用 TypeScript 或 Python 规划和构建高质量的 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，以实现 LLM 与外部 API 的连接。
scenarios: 为新的 MCP 服务集成规划 API 工具定义和功能覆盖范围。
为 MCP 开发选择合适的传输协议（stdio 或 HTTP）与上下文管理模式。
参照官方 SDK 最佳实践生成 TypeScript 或 Python 的 MCP 服务器实现代码。
zh.io: 输入服务 API 规范与集成需求，输出结构化的 MCP 服务器架构规划、工具设计方案及实现代码。
zh.boundary: 仅提供 MCP 服务器的设计指导与代码实现范式，不直接部署、托管或运行服务器实例。

en.purpose: Standardize and draft various internal company communications according to specified organizational templates and guidelines.
scenarios: Writing weekly 3P (Progress, Plans, Problems) updates for team tracking
Drafting company-wide newsletters or response documents for FAQs
Formulating leadership updates, project status reports, or incident reports
en.io: Takes raw updates, notes, or specific comms requests as input and outputs formatted internal communication drafts adhering to company style guidelines.
en.boundary: It only generates and formats internal communication text based on provided templates, without sending emails, publishing updates, or handling external communications.

zh.purpose: 根据指定的公司模板与规范，协助编写并标准化各类企业内部沟通文档。
scenarios: 撰写团队周度 3P（进度、计划、问题）更新汇报
起草全员公司新闻通讯或常见问题（FAQ）解答文档
编写高管汇报、项目状态更新或事故复盘报告
zh.io: 输入项目背景、笔记或沟通需求，输出符合公司格式规范的内部沟通文档草案。
zh.boundary: 仅负责根据本地模板撰写和格式化内部文本，不具备自动发送邮件、发布公告或处理外部沟通的功能。

en.purpose: Provides strategic creative guidance for crafting distinctive, non-templated frontend visual designs tailored to a product's unique subject and brand identity.
scenarios: Establishing an opinionated visual identity and aesthetic direction for a new web product
Redesigning an existing user interface to eliminate generic or AI-templated UI defaults
Selecting bespoke typography, color palettes, and motion interactions grounded in domain context
en.io: Accepts design briefs or user context and outputs tailored visual design directions, layout strategies, and typography recommendations.
en.boundary: Provides aesthetic and creative direction, but does not write backend implementation code, handle business logic, or generate direct asset files.

zh.purpose: 提供战略性的前端视觉设计指导，帮助根据具体主题制定独特、富有主见的 UI 方案并摆脱模板化设计。
scenarios: 为新 Web 产品确立符合领域特征且独特的视觉风格与审美方向
改造现有界面以摆脱同质化的 AI 或通用模板感
针对特定业务场景选择富有表现力的排版、配色与动效交互策略
zh.io: 接收项目需求或用户偏好，输出有主见的视觉设计方向、字体排版与布局规划建议。
zh.boundary: 仅提供前端审美与视觉设计指导，不涉及后端业务逻辑开发、系统架构或直接生成可交付的媒体资源文件。

en.purpose: Creates, reads, edits, and manipulates Microsoft Word (.docx and .dotx) documents using specialized scripts, XML manipulation, and rendering tools.
scenarios: Generating formatted Word reports, memos, or templates with tables of contents, page numbers, and custom styling.
Editing existing Word files by unzipping XML, merging broken text runs, and performing tracked changes or find-and-replace.
Converting Word documents to Markdown for content analysis or to PDF/images for visual output verification.
en.io: Inputs user content, text parameters, or existing .docx/.dotx files, and outputs formatted Word documents, extracted Markdown text, or verification images.
en.boundary: Does not process non-Word formats such as PDFs, spreadsheets, or Google Docs, nor does it handle general coding tasks unrelated to Word document generation.

zh.purpose: 通过专用脚本、XML 操作与渲染工具，创建、读取、编辑和处理 Microsoft Word（.docx 及 .dotx）文档。
scenarios: 生成包含目录、页码和自定义格式精美的 Word 报告、备忘录或模板。
通过解包 XML、合并文本块对现有 Word 文件进行查找替换或修订编辑。
将 Word 文档转换为 Markdown 提取内容，或转换为 PDF 及图片进行视觉效果校验。
zh.io: 输入用户文本内容、模板参数或现有的 .docx/.dotx 文件，输出排版完成的 Word 文档、提取的文本或校验图片。
zh.boundary: 不处理 PDF、电子表格或 Google Docs 等非 Word 格式，也不适用于与文档生成无关的通用编程任务。

en.purpose: Guides users through a structured three-stage workflow—Context Gathering, Refinement & Structure, and Reader Testing—to collaboratively author high-quality documentation.
scenarios: Drafting technical specifications, PRDs, RFCs, or architecture decision documents.
Structuring complex proposals by dumping unorganized project background and answering clarifying questions.
Testing document clarity by simulating how a fresh reader or AI will interpret the text to catch blind spots.
en.io: Inputs raw user info dumps, document templates, and feedback; outputs structured document sections and reader-testing feedback.
en.boundary: It does not automatically generate finished documents without user interaction, nor does it directly publish or manage documents in external platforms.

zh.purpose: 通过“上下文收集、结构提炼、读者测试”三个阶段的结构化流程，引导用户协作撰写高质量文档。
scenarios: 起草技术规范、PRD、RFC 或决策文档。
通过倾倒零散的项目背景并回答引导性问题，梳理复杂的提案文档。
模拟无上下文读者或 AI 的视角测试文档可读性，找出内容盲点。
zh.io: 输入用户倾倒的信息、文档模板及修改意见，输出结构化的文档草案和盲点评估反馈。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 不会在缺乏用户参与的情况下自动独立生成最终文档，也不会直接将文档发布到外部平台。

en.purpose: Provides reference guidelines and integration standards for building LLM applications using the official Claude API and Anthropic SDKs.
scenarios: Integrating Anthropic SDKs into Python, TypeScript, or other supported language projects.
Configuring Claude API features such as streaming, adaptive thinking, tool use, MCP, and prompt caching.
Migrating Claude model versions, looking up model IDs, pricing, and token counting.
en.io: Inputs user developer prompts and codebase context; outputs production-ready code snippets and configurations using official Anthropic SDKs or raw HTTP calls.
en.boundary: It does not provide implementation code for non-Anthropic providers like OpenAI or Gemini, nor does it generate code using unofficial provider shims.

zh.purpose: 为使用 Claude API 和 Anthropic 官方 SDK 开发大模型应用提供标准指南与参考规范。
scenarios: 在 Python、TypeScript 或其他语言项目中集成 Anthropic 官方 SDK
配置 Claude API 特性（如流式传输、自适应思考、工具调用、MCP 及提示词缓存）
进行 Claude 模型迁移、查询模型 ID、价格计算及 Token 统计
zh.io: 输入用户的开发需求与项目代码上下文，输出符合 Anthropic 官方规范的代码片段与配置。
zh.boundary: 不适用于 OpenAI、Gemini 等非 Anthropic 大模型提供商的代码生成，也不支持使用非官方的兼容垫片库。

en.purpose: Creates original visual artwork, posters, and graphic designs by first formulating an aesthetic philosophy and then rendering corresponding PNG or PDF visual assets.
scenarios: Designing a visual poster or graphic artwork from a concept prompt
Drafting a custom visual design philosophy and artistic manifesto
Generating high-craft static design assets with minimal textual clutter
en.io: Takes prompt themes or minimal design instructions as input, and outputs Markdown philosophy documents (.md) alongside rendered visual files (.png, .pdf).
en.boundary: Does not replicate existing copyrighted artists' work, nor does it produce text-heavy explanatory documents or interactive web elements.

zh.purpose: 通过先构建视觉设计哲学再生成对应 PNG 或 PDF 视觉资产的方式，创作原创的视觉艺术作品和海报。
scenarios: 根据创意提示词设计视觉海报或平面艺术作品
制定并撰写定制的视觉设计哲学与艺术宣言
生成注重视觉表现、少文字的精美静态平面设计资产
zh.io: 输入视觉主题或简要设计需求，输出设计哲学文档（.md）及渲染生成的艺术作品文件（.png、.pdf）。
zh.boundary: 不复制现有艺术家的版权作品，也不生成以大段文字为主的文档或交互式网页布局。

en.purpose: Applies Anthropic's official brand visual identity, including specific color palettes and typography standards, to generated artifacts.
scenarios: Styling presentation slides or pitch decks to match Anthropic's brand visual standard.
Applying brand-compliant heading and body typography to generated documents.
Coloring visual elements and document shapes using official Anthropic accent colors.
en.io: Inputs unstyled content or document elements and outputs visually formatted artifacts incorporating Anthropic's official colors and typography.
en.boundary: It only handles visual styling and formatting rules, without generating original textual content or automatically installing missing system fonts.

zh.purpose: 将 Anthropic 的官方品牌视觉标识（包括特定调色板和字体规范）应用到生成的各种构件中。
scenarios: 美化演示文稿幻灯片，使其符合 Anthropic 的品牌外观。
为生成的文档应用符合品牌规范的标题和正文字体及颜色。
使用官方品牌强调色格式化视觉图表和形状元素。
zh.io: 输入未设置样式的文本或文档元素，输出套用了 Anthropic 品牌色彩与字体的格式化构件。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅负责视觉排版与色彩字体的应用，不负责创作实际文本内容或自动安装缺失的系统字体。

en.purpose: Creates original generative and algorithmic art using p5.js by first formulating a computational art philosophy and then implementing it through interactive code.
scenarios: Generating interactive p5.js generative art sketches based on user concepts
Creating flow field or particle system algorithmic visualizations
Drafting computational art manifestos and aesthetic philosophy documents
en.io: Inputs user prompts or artistic ideas, and outputs a Markdown philosophy document alongside interactive HTML and JavaScript p5.js files.
en.boundary: It does not output pre-rendered static image files or replicate copyrighted artworks from existing artists.

zh.purpose: 通过构建计算艺术哲学并使用 p5.js 编写可交互代码，来创作原创的生成式与算法艺术作品。
scenarios: 根据用户概念生成可交互的 p5.js 生成艺术草图
构建流场或粒子系统等算法可视化模拟
撰写计算艺术宣言与美学哲学文档
zh.io: 输入用户的提示词或艺术构想，输出 Markdown 格式的哲学文档以及包含 p5.js 的 HTML/JS 代码文件。
zh.boundary: 它不直接输出预渲染的静态图像文件，也不复制现存艺术家的受版权保护作品。

en.purpose: Build, validate, and smoke-test the claude-osint skills repository and its embedded Python helper scripts.
scenarios: Running full smoke test suites on the claude-osint repository
Validating YAML frontmatter metadata and triggers across SKILL.md files
Testing secret scanning and HackerOne reference retrieval Python scripts
en.io: Accepts repository files, command-line flags, or stdin text, and outputs PASS/FAIL log reports alongside JSON/JSONL scan results.
en.boundary: It only validates repository structure and script functionality, and does not serve as an OSINT execution application or install external code linters.

zh.purpose: 构建、验证并冒烟测试 claude-osint 技能存储库及其内置的 Python 辅助脚本。
scenarios: 运行 claude-osint 存储库的完整冒烟测试套件
验证各个 SKILL.md 文件的 YAML 前置元数据结构与触发词
单独测试密钥扫描和 HackerOne 漏洞参考获取等 Python 脚本
zh.io: 输入为存储库文件、命令行参数或标准输入文本，输出为 PASS/FAIL 状态日志及 JSON/JSONL 格式的扫描结果。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅用于验证本地存储库结构与脚本功能，本身并非交互式 OSINT 应用，也不包含外部 Lint 工具的自动安装与运行。

en.purpose: Provides a structured, stage-gated methodology for conducting authorized external reconnaissance, attack surface mapping, and identity profiling in red-team engagements.
scenarios: Mapping an organization's external attack surface and exposed cloud perimeter assets
Conducting identity fabric mapping and breach correlation for red-team targeting
Prioritizing discovered exposures and generating executive or bug bounty reporting deliverables
en.io: Takes target domains, organization seeds, or individual identities as input, and outputs structured asset graphs, confidence-graded intelligence dossiers, and client deliverables.
en.boundary: It does not perform active exploitation, post-exploitation, malware development, blue-team detection configuration, or unauthorized target assessments.

zh.purpose: 为授权的外部红队演练、攻击面梳理与目标身份分析提供阶段化且严谨的开源情报（OSINT）调查方法论。
scenarios: 梳理与映射目标组织的外部数字攻击面及云端边界暴露资产
在红队项目中执行身份基础设施拓扑映射与凭据泄露关联分析
评估已知漏洞暴露优先级并生成客户交付报告或漏洞赏金提交材料
zh.io: 输入目标域名种子、组织名称或个人身份信息，输出结构化的资产图谱、置信度分级的调查档案以及客户交付物。
zh.boundary: 该技能不提供主动漏洞利用、后渗透攻击、恶意软件开发、蓝队防御检测配置以及未授权目标的测试操作。

en.purpose: This skill automates an end-to-end external OSINT and attack surface reconnaissance pipeline for a target domain.
scenarios: Automated external attack surface discovery for an authorized domain
Subdomain enumeration, endpoint harvesting, and HTTP service probing
Generating a consolidated multi-tab Excel workbook of OSINT evidence
en.io: Takes a target domain name as input and outputs structured evidence files along with a consolidated multi-tab .xlsx report.
en.boundary: It executes Stages 1–5 of reconnaissance but strictly stops short of Stage 6 active exploitation and scanning out-of-scope domains.

zh.purpose: 该 Skill 用于自动化执行针对目标域名的端到端外部 OSINT 与攻击面侦察流程。
scenarios: 针对已授权域名进行自动化的外部攻击面梳理
子域名枚举、端点信息收集与 HTTP 服务探测
汇总侦察证据并自动生成多标签页 Excel 报告
zh.io: 输入目标域名及范围参数，输出结构化的侦察证据文件及整合的多标签页 .xlsx 报告。
zh.boundary: 仅自动执行阶段 1–5 的信息收集与枚举，严格禁止执行阶段 6 的主动漏洞利用及超出授权范围的资产扫描。

en.purpose: Maps an organization's complete corporate family tree and owned internet footprint starting from its legal name or entity identity using passive OSINT and strict attribution discipline.
scenarios: Mapping corporate-family internet assets and shadow IT sprawl for M&A due diligence or security auditing.
Resolving a legal entity name to LEI identifiers and subsidiary hierarchies using SEC-EDGAR and corporate registries.
Discovering unlinked dark netblocks, owned domains, and ASNs while guarding against cloud/CDN over-attribution.
en.io: Takes a company's legal name or seed entity identity as input and outputs an attributed corporate hierarchy along with verified domains, netblocks, ASNs, and prioritized candidate assets.
en.boundary: It performs passive OSINT discovery and attribution analysis without executing active vulnerability scans or intrusive testing on discovered assets.

zh.purpose: 该技能基于被动 OSINT 和严格的归因规则，从公司法定名称或实体身份出发梳理完整的企业家族及所属网络资产图谱。
scenarios: 在并购调查或安全审计中评估企业家族的完整网络资产与影子 IT 蔓延。
利用 SEC-EDGAR 及企业注册库将公司法定名称解析为 LEI 标识和子公司层级结构。
发现无 DNS 关联的网段、所属域名及 ASN，同时防止对云服务提供商或 CDN 共享网段的过度归因。
zh.io: 输入公司法定名称或种子实体身份，输出包含归因置信度分级的企业架构图以及关联的域名、网段、ASN 和候选资产列表。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅进行被动的 OSINT 资产发现与置信度归因，不会对发现的网络资产发起主动漏洞扫描或入侵测试。

en.purpose: Provide a comprehensive operational arsenal and reference catalog of wordlists, secret-detection regexes, search dorks, and probe templates for authorized external red-team and bug-bounty reconnaissance.
scenarios: Conducting external attack surface mapping and asset fingerprinting during red-team exercises.
Scanning mobile APKs, public repositories, and web endpoints for leaked credentials and API keys.
Performing post-discovery enumeration on identity endpoints, cloud buckets, and email security configurations.
en.io: Inputs target domain names, IP addresses, code repositories, or APK files; outputs detailed recon findings, secret matches, verified endpoint scores, and attack-path hints.
en.boundary: This skill focuses strictly on external reconnaissance, asset discovery, and secret validation, without executing direct vulnerability exploitation or intrusive attack payloads.

zh.purpose: 为授权的外网红队演练与漏洞赏金项目提供涵盖字典、密钥正则、搜索语法及探测脚本的高效信息收集综合资源库。
scenarios: 在红队演练中对目标外网资产进行攻击面梳理与服务指纹识别。
扫描移动端 APK、开源代码仓库及 Web 接口以查找泄露的敏感凭据与 API 密钥。
针对身份认证端点、云存储桶及邮件安全配置进行深度枚举与校验。
zh.io: 输入目标域名、IP 地址、代码仓库或 APK 文件，输出结构化的情报收集结果、密钥匹配信息、接口评分及攻击路径提示。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅专注于外网情报收集、资产发现与凭据校验，不直接提供主动漏洞利用或高对抗性的攻击 Payload 执行。

en.purpose: Provides organization-grade identity-fabric mapping and pre-authentication user enumeration methodology without performing credential submission.
scenarios: Mapping tenant and federation boundaries during authorized attack surface management.
Fingerprinting Identity Providers (IdP) such as Entra ID, Okta, ADFS, and Google Workspace.
Generating and validating login candidate patterns for pre-auth user enumeration.
en.io: Takes target domain names, organization slugs, or name lists as input and outputs identity provider fingerprints, tenant/federation maps, and structured user enumeration results.
en.boundary: It strictly performs discovery and enumeration, explicitly prohibiting password spraying, credential submission, or authentication bypass.

zh.purpose: 提供组织级的身份体系结构映射与预认证用户枚举方法，不执行任何凭据提交或认证攻击。
scenarios: 在授权的攻击面管理（ASM）中映射租户与联合身份边界。
对 Entra ID、Okta、ADFS 和 Google Workspace 等身份提供商（IdP）进行指纹识别。
生成并验证用于预认证用户枚举的登录候选模式。
zh.io: 输入目标域名、组织标识或姓名列表，输出身份提供商指纹、租户/联合结构图及结构化的用户枚举结果。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅限于侦察与枚举，严格禁止密码喷射、凭据提交或身份验证绕过。

en.purpose: Quantifies completed recon findings into a defensible 0-100/A-F risk score, dollar-denominated FAIR loss estimates, and executive board deliverables.
scenarios: Translating technical OSINT findings into dollar-denominated loss magnitude for C-suite reporting.
Computing FAIR-aligned organizational risk scores with ownership and proof demotion caps.
Modeling red-team attack paths and kill-chain amplifications from asset data.
Generating a board-ready one-pager report with risk grades, top findings, and remediation asks.
en.io: Inputs completed recon findings, asset inventory, and proof annotations; outputs calculated risk scores, FAIR loss ranges, attack path models, and a board-ready executive report.
en.boundary: It performs passive offline analysis on previously collected data and does not conduct active scanning, network probing, or external intelligence gathering.

zh.purpose: 基于 FAIR 方法论将已收集的侦察发现量化为 0-100/A-F 风险评分、美元计价的损失预测及董事会执行报告。
scenarios: 将技术层面的 OSINT 侦察结果转化为面向高管的美元化数据泄露成本预测。
计算结合资产归属与凭证打折上限的 FAIR 组织风险评分（0-100 分及 A-F 等级）。
依据现有资产图谱建模红队攻击路径与杀伤链放大效应。
生成包含风险等级、财务影响、核心发现及整改建议的董事会单页报告。
zh.io: 输入为已收集的侦察发现、资产及归属验证标记，输出为计算出的风险评分、FAIR 损失预测、攻击路径模型及董事会单页报告。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅对已有数据进行离线被动分析，不进行任何主动的网络探测、目标扫描或新的情报收集。

en.purpose: Evaluates email spoofing feasibility and SPF supply-chain risks based purely on published DNS records.
scenarios: Auditing email spoofing feasibility and DMARC/SPF enforcement posture for a target domain.
Investigating SPF PermError lookup limits and analyzing long include chains.
Identifying SPF include takeover vulnerabilities caused by dangling include domains.
Generating client-ready security audit reports explaining complex email authentication flaws.
en.io: Accepts raw DNS TXT records for a domain as input and outputs a structured spoofability verdict, severity rating, and supply-chain risk assessment.
en.boundary: Performs strictly passive DNS record analysis and does not perform active SMTP probes, send test emails, or evaluate non-email security postures.

zh.purpose: 仅基于公开的 DNS 记录评估电子邮件伪造可行性及 SPF 供应链风险。
scenarios: 评估目标域名的邮件发件人伪造可行性与 DMARC/SPF 强制执行策略。
调查 SPF PermError 查询限制（如 10 次 DNS 查询限制）并分析 include 引用链。
检测因失效或已解绑域名导致的 SPF include 供应链接管风险。
撰写包含详细邮件认证漏洞解释的客户端安全审计报告。
zh.io: 输入为域名的原始 DNS TXT 记录，输出为结构化的伪造可行性结论、风险等级与供应链风险评估。
zh.boundary: 仅进行纯被动的 DNS 记录分析，不执行主动 SMTP 探测、不发送测试邮件，也不评估非邮件类的安全姿态。

en.purpose: Converts single external reconnaissance scans into a continuous exposure monitoring program using scheduled re-scans, asset/finding diffing, threat intelligence chatter tracking, and lifecycle management.
scenarios: Setting up scheduled perimeter re-scans and delta alert notifications for an MSSP engagement.
Tracking adversary chatter and brand mentions across ransomware leak sites, Telegram, and public forums.
Managing finding lifecycles and suppressing alert fatigue for risk-accepted security issues.
Building reports comparing attack surface changes and perimeter drift over time.
en.io: Inputs scan snapshots, watchlist targets, and CTI feeds; outputs delta alerts, asset diff reports, and finding lifecycle status updates.
en.boundary: Performs passive OSINT analysis, scan diffing, and alert orchestration only, without executing active intrusion techniques or unauthorized exploitation.

zh.purpose: 将单次外部侦察转换为包含定期重新扫描与差异比对、威胁情报讨论监控及漏洞生命周期管理的持续暴露面监控程序。
scenarios: 为托管安全服务（MSSP）项目配置定期的边界重新扫描与增量告警通知。
在勒索软件泄露网站、Telegram 及公共论坛上监控针对特定品牌的威胁情报与讨论。
管理漏洞发现生命周期，避免针对已接受风险问题的告警疲劳。
生成展示攻击面随时间演变及边界漂移情况的比对报告。
zh.io: 输入扫描快照、监控清单与 CTI 订阅源，输出增量告警、资产差异报告及发现生命周期状态更新。
zh.boundary: 仅执行被动 OSINT 分析、差异比对与告警推送，不涉及主动入侵或未经授权的漏洞利用。

en.purpose: Discovers and analyzes cloud storage buckets, supply-chain dependency confusion risks, AWS account IDs from keys, and exposed cloud-native control planes for passive security reconnaissance.
scenarios: Enumerating target cloud storage buckets (S3, GCS, Azure Blob) and triaging sensitive object keys.
Recovering AWS account IDs offline from leaked AKIA/ASIA/AROA access keys using standard base32 decoding.
Confirming npm and PyPI dependency-confusion vectors using read-only registry checks without uploading packages.
Fingerprinting cloud-native services, Kubernetes instances, and CI/CD control planes for organization attribution.
en.io: Accepts domain names, organization tokens, leaked access keys, or package names, and outputs verified cloud asset inventories, recovered AWS account IDs, and dependency confusion verification reports.
en.boundary: Performs purely passive discovery and offline analysis, strictly prohibiting active vulnerability exploitation, credential submissions, or active control-plane validation.

zh.purpose: 用于被动云资源与供应链暴露面侦查，涵盖存储桶发现与估值、离线AWS账号ID还原、依赖混乱漏洞确认及云原生与CI控制面指纹识别。
scenarios: 枚举并评估目标组织的 S3/GCS/Azure 存储桶及其敏感文件列表。
利用 Python 标准库通过离线 base32 解密将泄露的 AKIA/ASIA/AROA 密钥还原为 AWS 账号 ID。
通过只读注册表比对确认 npm/PyPI 的私有包依赖混乱漏洞风险。
被动识别 Lambda、Kubernetes、Jenkins 等云原生及 CI/CD 控制面的暴露状态与组织归属。
zh.io: 输入目标域名、组织标记、泄露的 AWS 访问密钥或内部包名，输出结构化的云资产清单、还原的账号 ID 以及依赖混乱验证报告。
zh.boundary: 仅支持被动收集与离线分析，严格禁止任何形式的漏洞利用、凭据提交或主动控制面验证测试。

en.purpose: Provides expert assistance in designing, developing, and optimizing Django web applications and Django REST Framework APIs.
scenarios: Designing Django ORM models with proper database indexing and query optimizations like select_related/prefetch_related.
Building RESTful APIs with DRF serializers, viewsets, and JWT authentication.
Writing automated backend unit tests and API tests using Django APITestCase.
en.io: Accepts backend feature specifications or schema requirements, and produces production-ready Django Python code, serializers, viewsets, and test cases.
en.boundary: Does not cover frontend UI framework development, non-Django Python web frameworks, or cloud infrastructure provisioning.

zh.purpose: 提供在设计、开发和优化 Django Web 应用程序及 Django REST Framework API 方面的专业支持。
scenarios: 设计 Django ORM 数据模型并使用索引及 select_related/prefetch_related 进行查询优化。
构建包含 Serializer、ViewSet 和 JWT 身份验证的 DRF RESTful API 接口。
使用 Django APITestCase 编写后端单元测试与 API 测试用例。
zh.io: 输入为后端功能需求或数据模型定义，输出为生产级的 Django/DRF Python 代码、序列化器、视图及测试用例。
zh.boundary: 不包含前端 UI 框架开发、非 Django 的 Python Web 框架以及云端基础设施运维部署。

en.purpose: Provides end-to-end DevOps automation including CI/CD pipeline setup, infrastructure as code, application containerization, and deployment orchestration.
scenarios: Configuring CI/CD workflows with GitHub Actions or GitLab CI
Containerizing applications with Docker and authoring Kubernetes manifests
Provisioning cloud infrastructure using Terraform or Pulumi templates
Executing deployment strategies like canary or blue-green rollouts and incident runbooks
en.io: Accepts application specifications, cloud provider constraints, and pipeline requirements as inputs, and outputs valid Dockerfiles, IaC code, CI/CD workflow configurations, or K8s manifests.
en.boundary: Focuses on infrastructure automation and delivery pipelines, and does not write application business logic or execute destructive infrastructure changes without explicit user approval.

zh.purpose: 提供端到端的 DevOps 自动化能力，涵盖 CI/CD 流水线构建、基础设施即代码、应用容器化及部署编排。
scenarios: 使用 GitHub Actions 或 GitLab CI 配置自动化构建与发布流水线
使用 Docker 容器化应用并编写 Kubernetes 部署清单
使用 Terraform 或 Pulumi 编写云基础设施编写代码模板
设计蓝绿/金丝雀部署策略及编写生产故障响应 Runbook
zh.io: 输入应用架构规范、云服务商条件及流水线需求，输出可直接使用的 Dockerfile、IaC 脚本、CI/CD 配置文件或 K8s 清单。
zh.boundary: 专注于基础设施自动化与交付配置，不编写应用业务逻辑代码，也不在未经用户明确批准的情况下直接执行高风险生产部署。

en.purpose: Systematically analyzes error messages, logs, and stack traces using a hypothesis-driven workflow to identify root causes and resolve software bugs.
scenarios: Investigating unexpected application crashes and parsing stack traces
Tracking down regressions using strategies like git bisect
Correlating multi-component log entries to isolate system failure points
Developing targeted regression tests following a bug fix
en.io: Inputs codebases, stack traces, error logs, or bug reports, and outputs a root cause analysis with supporting evidence, code fixes, and prevention steps.
en.boundary: This skill focuses on systematic bug isolation and root cause analysis rather than continuous production monitoring or making blind code changes without reproduction.

zh.purpose: 采用假设驱动的系统化方法，通过分析错误信息、日志和堆栈轨迹来精确定位并解决软件缺陷。
scenarios: 排查应用程序崩溃并解析异常堆栈轨迹
使用 git bisect 等策略追溯引入缺陷的代码提交
关联多组件日志记录以隔离系统故障点
修复 Bug 后编写针对性的回归测试用例
zh.io: 输入代码库、堆栈轨迹、错误日志或 Bug 报告，输出包含根本原因、证据、修复方案和预防措施的分析报告。
zh.boundary: 该技能专注于缺陷的系统化排查与原因隔离，不包含实时生产环境监控或未经重现步骤的盲目修改。

en.purpose: Optimizes query performance, index strategies, and system configurations across PostgreSQL and MySQL database systems.
scenarios: Analyzing slow database queries and execution plans using EXPLAIN ANALYZE
Designing covering indexes and partitioning strategies to minimize disk I/O
Tuning database server memory and query buffer configurations
Diagnosing and resolving database lock contention and deadlocks
en.io: Accepts SQL queries, EXPLAIN plan outputs, or database metrics, and outputs optimized queries, index creation statements, and tuning recommendations.
en.boundary: Does not handle automatic live database migrations or performance tuning for non-relational (NoSQL) databases.

zh.purpose: 针对 PostgreSQL 与 MySQL 数据库系统提供查询性能优化、索引策略设计与系统参数调优服务。
scenarios: 使用 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 分析慢查询日志与执行计划
设计覆盖索引与表分区策略以降低磁盘 I/O 开销
调整数据库服务器内存分配与缓冲区配置参数
排查并解决数据库并发锁争用及死锁问题
zh.io: 输入 SQL 查询语句、EXPLAIN 执行计划日志或数据库配置指标，输出优化后的 SQL 脚本、索引创建语句及参数调优建议。
zh.boundary: 不负责自动执行线上数据库结构迁移部署，也不提供非关系型（NoSQL）数据库的性能调优。

en.purpose: Provides expert guidance and code generation for building high-performance .NET 8+ applications, ASP.NET Core APIs, EF Core data access, and Blazor components.
scenarios: Building ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs or Controller-based REST endpoints
Configuring EF Core data models, contexts, and database migrations
Scaffolding Blazor web components with state management
Structuring backend applications with CQRS via MediatR and async workflows
en.io: Accepts application requirements or source code requests, returning implementation-ready C# code, DTOs, API endpoints, and unit tests.
en.boundary: This skill focuses strictly on C# and .NET application development and does not handle cloud infrastructure provisioning or non-Blazor frontend frameworks.

zh.purpose: 旨在协助开发者构建高性能的 .NET 8+ 应用程序、ASP.NET Core API、EF Core 数据访问层及 Blazor 组件。
scenarios: 构建基于 ASP.NET Core 的 Minimal API 或控制器 REST 接口
配置 EF Core 数据模型、Context 上下文及数据库 Migration 迁移
开发带状态管理的 Blazor Web UI 组件
使用 MediatR 与异步取消模式构建 CQRS 架构应用
zh.io: 接收 C# 应用开发需求或现有代码，输出生产就绪的 C# 源码、DTO、API 接口及单元测试。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 仅专注于 C# 与 .NET 领域的应用代码开发，不涵盖基础设施运维部署或非 Blazor 的前端技术栈。

en.purpose: Develops, refactors, optimizes, and debugs high-performance C++ applications using modern C++20/23 standards and system-level engineering practices.
scenarios: Implementing type-safe interfaces and zero-cost abstractions with C++20 concepts and ranges
Diagnosing and resolving memory leaks, undefined behavior, and concurrency issues using sanitizers
Optimizing memory layout, cache usage, and SIMD vectorization for performance-critical bottlenecks
Configuring CMake build systems and compiler warning options according to C++ Core Guidelines
en.io: Takes C++ source files, performance targets, or CMake configurations as input, and outputs refactored modern C++ source code, build scripts, or bug fixes.
en.boundary: It does not write code in languages other than C++, perform low-level hardware flashing, or handle end-user GUI layout design.

zh.purpose: 借助现代 C++20/23 标准与系统级工程实践，开发、重构、优化及调试高性能 C++ 应用程序。
scenarios: 使用 C++20 Concepts 与 Ranges 实现类型安全的零开销抽象接口
利用 Sanitizer 工具与静态分析诊断并修复内存泄漏、未定义行为及并发瓶颈
针对性能瓶颈开展内存布局、缓存优化与 SIMD 向量化指令集加速
按照 C++ Core Guidelines 配置 CMake 构建系统与编译器告警规则
zh.io: 输入 C++ 源代码、性能指标或 CMake 配置文件，输出重构后的现代 C++ 源码、构建脚本或缺陷修复方案。
zh.boundary: 它不承担非 C++ 语言的开发、缺乏标准工具链支持的硬件烧录，以及图形界面 (GUI) 的布局设计。

en.purpose: Performs comprehensive code reviews on diffs and source files to identify bugs, security vulnerabilities, code smells, and performance issues, producing a structured, actionable report.
scenarios: Reviewing pull requests for correctness, performance, and style consistency before merging.
Conducting code quality and architectural audits on existing repositories.
Identifying refactoring opportunities and anti-patterns such as N+1 queries or hardcoded secrets.
Validating test coverage and specification compliance for new implementations.
en.io: Accepts code diffs, source files, or PR descriptions as input and outputs a prioritized, categorized code review report.
en.boundary: Provides broad-scope static analysis and review feedback, but does not automatically refactor code, execute test suites, or replace deep specialized security auditing tools.

zh.purpose: 对代码 Diff 和源文件进行全面审查，识别 Bug、安全漏洞、代码恶臭及性能问题，并生成结构化的审查报告。
scenarios: 在合并代码前进行 Pull Request 审查，评估正确性、性能与规范一致性。
对现有代码库进行代码质量与架构审计。
识别代码重构机会以及 N+1 查询、硬编码密钥等常见反模式。
验证新功能实现的规范符合度与测试覆盖率。
zh.io: 输入代码 Diff、源文件或 PR 说明，输出包含按优先级分类建议的结构化代码审查报告。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅提供静态分析与审查建议，不能自动修补代码、执行测试套件或替代深度专业安全扫描工具。

en.purpose: Generates, formats, and validates inline code docstrings, API specifications, and technical developer documentation.
scenarios: Adding Google/NumPy-style Python docstrings or TypeScript JSDoc annotations to source code
Creating and linting OpenAPI/Swagger specifications for REST APIs
Writing getting-started guides, tutorials, or documentation portal content
en.io: Takes source code files or API definitions as input and outputs formatted docstrings, OpenAPI specs, markdown documentation, and validation report summaries.
en.boundary: Focuses on generating and validating technical documentation rather than writing core application logic or refactoring functional code.

zh.purpose: 生成、格式化并校验代码注释、API 接口规范以及开发者技术文档。
scenarios: 为 Python 或 TypeScript 源码添加 Google/NumPy 规范的 Docstring 或 JSDoc 注释
创建并使用 linter 校验 Web API 的 OpenAPI/Swagger 接口规范
撰写快速入门指南、开发教程或文档门户内容
zh.io: 输入源代码文件或 API 定义，输出格式化后的代码注释、OpenAPI 规范、Markdown 指南及校验报告。
zh.boundary: 专注于技术文档的生成与校验，不负责编写核心业务逻辑或重构代码实现。

en.purpose: Designs cloud architectures, migration plans, cost optimization recommendations, and disaster recovery strategies across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
scenarios: Designing multi-cloud landing zones and architectures following Well-Architected frameworks.
Planning cloud workload migrations using the 6Rs framework and defining cutover strategies.
Formulating disaster recovery strategies with defined RTO/RPO targets and zero-trust security.
Optimizing cloud infrastructure costs through right-sizing, reserved capacity, and FinOps practices.
en.io: Accepts cloud requirements, current infrastructure state, and compliance constraints as input, and outputs architectural designs, migration plans, cost analysis, and disaster recovery strategies.
en.boundary: Provides architectural designs, recommendations, and validation CLI commands, but does not directly execute hands-on infrastructure provisioning or application deployments.

zh.purpose: 跨 AWS、Azure 和 GCP 提供云架构设计、迁移计划、成本优化建议以及灾难恢复策略。
scenarios: 根据云架构最佳实践框架设计多云架构与落地区（Landing Zone）。
使用 6R 框架规划云工作负载迁移并制定割接与连通性验证方案。
制定具有明确 RTO/RPO 目标及零信任安全基线的灾难恢复策略。
通过资源合理配置、预留容量和 FinOps 实践优化云基础设施成本。
zh.io: 输入云需求、现有基础设施现状与合规约束，输出云架构设计图/文档、迁移计划、成本优化建议与容灾方案。
zh.boundary: 仅提供架构设计指南、迁移策略和验证命令，不直接代为执行云资源的实际部署或应用代码更改。

en.purpose: Guides the design, implementation, and polish of cross-platform command-line applications and shell completion scripts using popular CLI frameworks.
scenarios: Building a new cross-platform CLI application with subcommands using Commander, Click, Typer, or Cobra
Adding interactive prompts, progress indicators, and color formatting with TTY detection to terminal scripts
Generating shell completion scripts for bash, zsh, and fish while optimizing CLI startup performance
en.io: Inputs include application requirements, CLI specifications, and framework preferences; outputs include production-ready CLI source code and completion scripts.
en.boundary: This skill focuses on command-line interface development and does not design graphical user interfaces, manage backend API architectures, or handle server infrastructure deployment.

zh.purpose: 指导使用主流 CLI 框架进行跨平台命令行工具设计、代码实现与 Shell 自动补全生成。
scenarios: 使用 Commander、Click、Typer 或 Cobra 构建支持子命令和参数解析的跨平台 CLI 应用
为终端脚本添加交互式提示、进度条以及带 TTY 检测的彩色文本样式
生成 Bash、Zsh 及 Fish 的自动补全脚本并优化 CLI 的启动性能与 CI/CD 兼容性
zh.io: 输入为命令行工具的功能需求与框架偏好，输出为跨平台 CLI 源代码及对应的 Shell 补全脚本。
zh.boundary: 本技能仅专注于终端命令行应用的设计与代码实现，不包含 GUI 界面开发、后端服务架构设计或服务器部署运维。

en.purpose: Designs chaos experiments, creates failure injection frameworks, and facilitates game day exercises to build resilient distributed systems.
scenarios: Designing controlled chaos experiments with defined blast radius and automated rollback procedures.
Configuring failure injection tools such as Litmus Chaos or Chaos Monkey for Kubernetes and infrastructure.
Planning and conducting team game day exercises and generating post-mortem templates.
Integrating continuous chaos testing into CI/CD pipelines for ongoing resilience verification.
en.io: Inputs system architecture details and stability requirements, and outputs experiment manifests, injection scripts, monitoring configurations, rollback plans, and learning templates.
en.boundary: This skill generates chaos engineering designs and code manifests, but does not directly execute live failure injections in production or automate real-time system recovery.

zh.purpose: 设计混沌实验、构建故障注入框架并主持 Game Day 演练，以提升分布式系统的复原力与稳定性。
scenarios: 设计具有受控爆炸半径和自动回滚机制的混沌实验方案。
在 Kubernetes 或基础设施中配置 Litmus Chaos 或 Chaos Monkey 等故障注入框架。
筹划与主持团队 Game Day 演练并生成复盘总结模板。
将混沌测试集成至 CI/CD 流水线以进行持续弹性验证。
zh.io: 输入系统架构信息与稳定性要求，输出实验设计文档、故障注入清单、监控配置、回滚脚本及复盘模板。
zh.boundary: 本技能仅提供混沌实验方案设计与相关代码及配置生成，不直接在实际生产环境中执行故障注入操作或替代人工进行实时系统恢复。

en.purpose: Provides guidance and workflows for managing Jira project tracking and Confluence documentation through Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
scenarios: Querying and updating Jira issues and sprint backlogs using JQL
Searching, creating, and editing Confluence pages using CQL
Configuring MCP server authentication and setting up API workflows
en.io: Accepts user requests, JQL/CQL query strings, or issue/page payload data as input, and outputs executed Atlassian MCP tool calls, query results, or configuration files.
en.boundary: It does not host Atlassian services natively or bypass user permissions, requiring an active MCP server and valid API credentials to operate.

zh.purpose: 提供通过 MCP 协议管理 Jira 项目追踪和 Confluence 文档协同的操作指南与工作流建议。
scenarios: 使用 JQL 查询、更新 Jira 工单及管理 Sprint 迭代 backlog
使用 CQL 搜索、创建和编辑 Confluence 知识库页面
配置 Atlassian MCP 服务端的身份认证与工作流搭建
zh.io: 接收用户的自然语言需求、JQL/CQL 查询语句或卡片/页面数据作为输入，输出对应的 Atlassian MCP 工具调用指令、查询结果或配置方案。
zh.boundary: 该技能本身不直接托管 Jira/Confluence 服务，也不能绕过 Atlassian 自身的权限管控，必须依托已部署的 MCP 服务端和有效凭证执行具体操作。

en.purpose: Design, review, and document high-level system architectures while evaluating technology trade-offs and authoring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
scenarios: Designing new system architectures or microservices structures for a project
Evaluating technology trade-offs and drafting Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
Reviewing existing architecture to identify performance bottlenecks and plan for scalability
en.io: Accepts functional and non-functional requirements along with system constraints; outputs architecture documentation containing Mermaid diagrams, ADRs, and technology recommendations.
en.boundary: Focuses strictly on high-level system design and architectural decisions, excluding code-level design pattern implementation and database-only design tasks.

zh.purpose: 进行高层级系统架构的设计、审查与文档化，并通过架构决策记录（ADR）对技术选型进行权衡分析。
scenarios: 为新项目设计可扩展的微服务或单体系统架构
评估技术选型权衡并撰写架构决策记录（ADR）
审查现有系统架构以识别性能瓶颈并制定扩展计划
zh.io: 接收功能/非功能需求及系统约束条件；输出包含 Mermaid 架构图、ADR 决策文档及技术选型建议的架构设计方案。
zh.boundary: 仅专注于高层级的系统设计和架构决策，不包含代码层面的设计模式实现或纯数据库级的具体设计任务。

en.purpose: Provides architectural guidance and design specifications for REST and GraphQL APIs using OpenAPI 3.1 standards.
scenarios: Designing and writing OpenAPI 3.1 specifications for new or existing endpoints
Establishing API versioning, deprecation policies, and backward-compatibility strategies
Standardizing pagination patterns, URI structures, and RFC 7807 error handling
Linting and mocking API contracts using CLI tools
en.io: Input consists of business requirements and domain data models, and output is a complete OpenAPI 3.1 contract specification along with architectural patterns.
en.boundary: Focuses purely on API interface design and contract specifications without implementing actual backend server code or database logic.

zh.purpose: 提供 REST 与 GraphQL API 的架构设计指导，并构建符合 OpenAPI 3.1 标准的规范文档。
scenarios: 为新旧端点设计并编写符合 OpenAPI 3.1 规范的接口定义
规划 API 版本控制、废弃策略与向后兼容方案
统一分页模式、URI 结构以及 RFC 7807 错误处理标准
使用命令行工具对 API 契约进行语法校验与 Mock 模拟
zh.io: 输入业务需求与领域数据模型，输出完整的 OpenAPI 3.1 接口规范文件及架构设计方案。
zh.boundary: 仅专注于 API 接口契约设计与架构规划，不包含具体的后端业务逻辑或数据库代码实现。

en.purpose: Provides expert guidance and code generation for building, architecting, and optimizing enterprise Angular 17+ applications using standalone components, Signals, NgRx, and RxJS.
scenarios: Generating standalone Angular components with signal-based inputs/outputs and OnPush change detection
Setting up enterprise-grade state management using NgRx store, effects, and selectors
Configuring advanced lazy-loaded routing architectures with guards and resolvers
Writing unit and integration tests using Angular TestBed with high coverage thresholds
en.io: Accepts specifications for Angular features or application architecture and produces production-ready Angular TypeScript code, route configurations, state management setups, and unit tests.
en.boundary: It focuses solely on Angular 17+ frontend development and does not implement backend API services, database schemas, or non-Angular frontend applications.

zh.purpose: 为构建、设计和优化基于独立组件、Signals、NgRx 及 RxJS 的企业级 Angular 17+ 应用提供专家指导与代码生成。
scenarios: 生成带有 Signals 输入输出及 OnPush 变更检测策略的 Angular 独立组件
使用 NgRx Store、Effects 和 Selectors 构建企业级状态管理架构
配置带有路由守卫与解析器的高级懒加载路由系统
使用 Angular TestBed 编写符合覆盖率标准的高质量单元与集成测试
zh.io: 接收 Angular 功能需求或架构设计说明，并输出可直接投产的 TypeScript 代码、路由配置、状态管理逻辑及单元测试代码。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅专注于 Angular 17+ 前端开发，不涉及后端 API 服务实现、数据库设计或非 Angular 前端框架的构建。

en.purpose: Extracts and analyzes competitor ads from ad libraries to uncover effective messaging, creative patterns, and marketing strategies.
scenarios: Researching competitor ad messaging and targeted pain points in Facebook or LinkedIn Ad Libraries.
Comparing creative strategies across a set of competing brands.
Finding proven copywriting and visual concept inspiration for new ad campaigns.
en.io: Inputs competitor names or platform links; outputs extracted ad screenshots, categorized messaging breakdowns, and creative insights.
en.boundary: This skill analyzes publicly visible ad creatives and library data, but it cannot access private internal ad metrics (such as CTR or ROAS) or directly execute ad campaigns.

zh.purpose: 从广告库中提取并分析竞争对手的广告，揭示有效的文案痛点、创意模式与营销策略。
scenarios: 在 Facebook 或 LinkedIn 广告库中调研竞品的广告文案与针对的痛点。
横向对比多家竞争对手的广告创意策略与定位差异。
为新广告营销活动寻找经过验证的文案与视觉创意灵感。
zh.io: 输入竞品名称或平台链接；输出保存的广告截图、分类文案拆解及创意模式分析。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅提取和分析公开的广告创意与库数据，无法获取内部私密投放数据（如真实 CTR 或 ROAS）或直接代操作广告投放。

en.purpose: Automatically transforms technical git commit history into clear, categorized, and customer-friendly changelogs.
scenarios: Preparing release notes for new software versions or app store submissions.
Generating weekly or monthly user-facing product update summaries.
Creating formatted public changelog entries following custom style guidelines.
en.io: Takes git commit logs or date ranges as input and outputs a formatted Markdown changelog.
en.boundary: It only generates and formats release text content and does not automatically publish notes to app stores, execute git commands on remote servers, or deploy releases.

zh.purpose: 通过分析 Git 提交历史，自动将其转化为结构清晰、通俗易懂的用户端更新日志与发布说明。
scenarios: 为新版本发布或应用商店提交准备 Release Notes。
生成每周或每月的面向用户的产品更新总结。
结合自定义样式指南生成标准化的 Markdown 格式 Changelog。
zh.io: 输入 Git 提交记录或日期范围（可附带样式指南），输出格式化的 Markdown 更新日志文本。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅负责生成和转换日志文本，不会自动将发布说明发布至外部平台、提交代码或执行版本部署。

en.purpose: Generates original visual art and graphic designs in PNG or PDF format by first formulating a custom visual design philosophy.
scenarios: Creating original artistic posters or visual graphic compositions
Developing a custom aesthetic philosophy manifesto for a visual project
Generating minimal-text graphic visual artworks exported as PNG or PDF files
en.io: Takes creative user prompts or design constraints as input, and outputs a visual philosophy Markdown file along with rendered PNG or PDF artwork.
en.boundary: It does not copy existing copyrighted artists' works, write text-heavy content, or generate multi-page textual document layouts.

zh.purpose: 根据自定义视觉设计理念，创作 PNG 或 PDF 格式的原创视觉艺术与平面设计作品。
scenarios: 根据用户提示词创作原创艺术海报或平面视觉作品
为视觉项目构建独特的美学设计理念与视觉宣言
生成以视觉图像为主、仅含少量修饰文字的 PNG 或 PDF 作品
zh.io: 输入用户的创意提示或设计需求，输出视觉美学理念 Markdown 文件以及渲染好的 PNG 或 PDF 艺术文件。
zh.boundary: 不复刻或抄袭现有的有版权艺术作品，也不创作以大段文字为主的文档排版或文本内容。

en.purpose: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors, typography, and visual styling guidelines to visual artifacts and presentations.
scenarios: Styling PowerPoint presentations with Anthropic's official brand fonts and color schemes.
Formatting document headers and body text using Poppins and Lora typography rules.
Applying consistent brand accent colors to geometric shapes and visual elements in documents.
en.io: Takes raw document elements or presentation files as input and outputs styled visual artifacts matching Anthropic brand guidelines.
en.boundary: This skill only handles visual styling and theme application; it does not generate original document content, design layouts from scratch, or automatically install missing system fonts.

zh.purpose: 为演示文稿和各类视觉产物应用 Anthropic 的官方品牌颜色、字体及视觉排版规范。
scenarios: 使用 Anthropic 官方品牌字体与配色方案美化 PowerPoint 演示文稿。
依据品牌规范将文档标题和正文字体统一排版为 Poppins 和 Lora。
为文档中的图形与视觉元素按轮换规则应用符合品牌调性的强调色。
zh.io: 输入未排版的原始文档或演示文稿文件，输出符合 Anthropic 品牌设计规范的美化产物。
zh.boundary: 该技能仅负责应用品牌视觉样式与配色主题，不负责撰写内容、重绘整体版面布局或自动安装缺失的系统字体。

en.purpose: Enables the creation, development, and bundling of complex, multi-component React and shadcn/ui applications into single-file HTML artifacts for Claude conversations.
scenarios: Building interactive Web applications with dynamic state management and routing
Creating rich frontend dashboards using pre-styled shadcn/ui components
Bundling multi-file React/TypeScript projects into a standalone self-contained HTML artifact
en.io: Inputs: Project name and React/TypeScript component source code; Outputs: A single inlined HTML artifact file (bundle.html).
en.boundary: Designed specifically for complex React applications and should not be used for simple single-file HTML/JSX snippets or backend API development.

zh.purpose: 基于 React、Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 初始化并打包复杂的多组件前端应用，生成适用于 Claude 对话的单文件 HTML Artifact。
scenarios: 构建需要复杂状态管理与前端路由的交互式 Web 应用
使用 shadcn/ui 丰富组件库快速搭建数据仪表盘或管理界面
将多文件结构的 React/TypeScript 工程打包归约为单个自包含的 HTML 文件
zh.io: 输入：项目名称与 React/TypeScript 组件源码；输出：单个嵌入所有依赖的 HTML Artifact 文件（bundle.html）。
zh.boundary: 仅适用于构建复杂的多组件前端应用，不适用于生成简单的单文件 HTML/JSX 代码片断或开发后端服务。

en.purpose: Automates ActiveCampaign marketing and CRM operations using the Composio toolkit through Rube MCP.
scenarios: Managing contacts, deals, and email lists within ActiveCampaign
Triggering and tracking marketing automation workflows
Executing bulk contact synchronization and updates via remote workbench tools
en.io: Accepts user automation tasks and session parameters, returning execution responses and operation statuses from ActiveCampaign.
en.boundary: Does not perform direct ActiveCampaign API interactions outside of Rube MCP or manage account billing and subscription plans.
